description:

CRM Operations Associate



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 AM EST, with a 1-hour unpaid break.

Salary: $2,600 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented CRM Operations Associate to support investor relations, marketing, and sales operations. In this role, you will manage and optimize HubSpot CRM, maintain accurate investor and marketing data, support campaign execution, streamline operational processes, and ensure a seamless experience throughout the investor lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve CRM performance, enhance reporting, and support strategic business initiatives.



Key Responsibilities:



Investor Relations

* Develop a deep understanding of the firm's investment strategies, investors, and portfolio.

* Customize HubSpot for investment pipelines, including new investments, amendments, and payoffs.

* Create and maintain customized dashboards, reports, and workflows throughout the investment lifecycle.

* Manage investor onboarding, account updates, and change requests while coordinating with fund administrators and custody partners.

* Maintain and expand the investor database in HubSpot, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.

* Assist with ad hoc projects, including annual audits, valuation processes, and cross-functional initiatives.

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

* Manage workflows to ensure deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately.



Marketing & CRM Operations

* Configure, maintain, and execute marketing campaigns within HubSpot.

* Ensure CRM integrations and marketing technology function effectively and align with business objectives.

* Optimize investor relations, marketing, and sales processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability.

* Collaborate with marketing, sales, and other internal teams to support integrated campaigns and improve CRM data quality.

* Build and maintain marketing
s, audience segments, automated workflows, landing pages, dashboards, and campaign reports.

* Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve lead nurturing and conversion.

* Support product positioning and messaging initiatives that align with investor relations, marketing, and sales objectives.

* Train internal teams on CRM best practices and promote consistent adoption of established processes.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree

* At least 3 years of experience owning CRM functions with preference given to those with the following HubSpot Certifications: 

* HubSpot Marketing Hub Software

* HubSpot Sales Hub Software

* Inbound Marketing (or Inbound)

* 4+ years of experience using HubSpot CRM in a marketing or project management role

* Familiarity with alternatives/private fund marketing preferred

* Resourceful, driven, and creative problem-solver

* Has a start-up mindset and has the desire to roll up their sleeves 

* Strong project management skills with ability to simultaneously handle multiple projects

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with impeccable attention to detail

* High level of integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.

* Data analysis capabilities and AI/tooling proficiency for process modernization

* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, with an ability to become familiar with firm-specific software



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Wholesale Sales Assistant
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING*****



Wholesale Sales Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1,200 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented Wholesale Sales Assistant to support our growing U.S. wholesale business. This role will serve as the primary coordinator for wholesale order documentation and ERP transactions while providing management with timely, accurate reports to support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sales order documentation, pricing verification, ERP order entry, purchase order creation, and sales reporting, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient order processing and exceptional customer support.



Key Responsibilities:



Order Processing & Documentation

* Create and maintain all required wholesale sales documentation.

* Verify customer purchase orders for completeness and accuracy.

* Create Sales Orders (SO) in the ERP system.

* Create Purchase Orders (PO) in the ERP system as required.

* Ensure all documentation complies with internal procedures before orders are released to Operations.



Pricing & Data Verification

* Verify customer pricing against approved pricing lists and contracts.

* Confirm that promotions, discounts, freight terms, and payment terms are accurately reflected.

* Identify pricing discrepancies and coordinate with Sales Management to resolve issues before order processing.



Sales Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare recurring sales reports for management.

* Track wholesale sales performance by customer, channel, product category, and salesperson.

* Maintain dashboards to monitor order status, shipments, backorders, inventory allocation, and sales trends.

* Support management with ad hoc reporting and data analysis.



ERP & Process Support

* Maintain accurate customer and order information within the ERP system.

* Ensure data integrity across Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, inventory allocation, and shipping records.

* Assist in developing standardized operating procedures and documentation.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives to streamline wholesale operations.



Customer Communication & Support

* Respond to wholesale customer inquiries and requests received through designated wholesale
 accounts.

* Provide timely updates regarding order status, product availability, shipping timelines, and documentation requests.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer inquiries and ensure accurate information is communicated.

* Escalate complex issues to Sales Management or the appropriate departments as needed.



Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Purchasing, Customer Service, and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

* Communicate order status updates and resolve documentation-related issues promptly.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* 1–3 years of experience in sales support, order management, customer service, operations, or a related role.

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic reporting.

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience using ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Acumatica, or similar platforms is preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Direct-Response Ad Copywriter — UGC Video Scripts (Remote, Part Time)
description:
Direct-Response Ad Copywriter — UGC Video Scripts (Remote, Part Time)



We're NoirLab, a performance-creative studio producing video ad scripts for e-commerce brands running paid traffic on Meta and TikTok. We're expanding our copy team and looking for writers who understand that a script's job is to sell, not to sound clever.



The work:



Write 3 short-form UGC video ad scripts per order, with each different concept/angle.

Create Voice Overs with Elevenlabs for each script 20-30 sec.

Research the product, pick the angle, write copy that converts cold traffic

Fast turnaround — same-day delivery on assigned orders



This is a part time job, with flexible time and freedom:



3 scripts per order - each video script is 20 to 30 seconds long.

A strong writer handles 3 - 5 orders/day — you control your own time and speed

6 days/week availability, with Sundays off

Fully remote



You'll thrive here if you:



Write direct-response, not "brand" fluff — you know the difference

Understand who you're writing to and how aware they already are of the problem and the solutions

Work fast without dropping quality, and take feedback without ego



Not a fit if: you're a general content/blog writer, you need long deadlines, or "direct response" is a new term to you.



To apply — read carefully, this is the filter:

Send (1) 2–3 samples of ad copy or short-video scripts you've written (DR, not blog posts), and (2) a 3–4 sentence answer to this: "You're writing an ad for a product the audience has never heard of, solving a problem they don't yet know they have. How do you open?"



Applications without the written answer will not be reviewed.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
We are looking for an energetic and commercially minded **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** based in the Philippines to help grow our UK customer base.



We provide businesses with an **all-in-one HR and people platform combined with access to experienced HR and business consultants**. Our solution helps organisations manage their people more effectively, reduce HR administration, improve compliance and develop their managers and employees.



### The Role



Your primary responsibility is simple: **create quality sales conversations with UK businesses.**



You will identify and contact decision-makers within companies, understand their current HR challenges and introduce our software and consultancy solutions where there is a genuine opportunity.



This is primarily an **outbound B2B sales and appointment-setting role**.



You will:



* Research and identify suitable UK companies and decision-makers.

* Contact CEOs, Managing Directors, HR Directors, Heads of People, Finance Directors and other senior leaders.

* Make outbound telephone calls to prospective customers.

* Use
 and LinkedIn to support your outreach.

* Work from prospect lists and lead-generation tools provided by us.

* Introduce our HR software, HR consultancy and related people solutions.

* Ask good questions to understand the prospect's current situation and challenges.

* Qualify genuine sales opportunities.

* Book qualified meetings and demonstrations directly into our team's calendars.

* Follow up prospects who are interested but not yet ready to meet.

* Keep accurate records of conversations, activities and opportunities within our CRM.

* Work closely with our UK team to continuously improve messaging, targeting and conversion.



### Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is **confident speaking to senior business people on the telephone**.



You should have:



* Previous B2B outbound sales, telesales, SDR or appointment-setting experience.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* A confident and professional telephone manner.

* Experience making cold calls.

* The ability to build rapport quickly.

* Good questioning and listening skills.

* Confidence handling objections and rejection.

* Strong organisation and follow-up skills.

* Experience using CRM, LinkedIn and prospecting tools.

* A reliable internet connection and suitable remote-working environment.

* The ability to work UK business hours.



Experience selling **HR software, SaaS, business software, professional services, recruitment, HR services or consultancy** would be particularly valuable.



### What We Provide



You won't be expected to figure everything out yourself.



We provide:



* Target customer profiles.

* Prospecting and lead-generation tools.

* Sales training.

* Product and HR industry training.

* Messaging and sales playbooks.

* CRM and sales systems.

* Ongoing coaching from the UK team.

* Clear targets and performance measures.



### Compensation



**£500 GBP monthly base salary + commission.**



There is **no cap on commission**. Strong performance will therefore significantly increase your total earnings.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business. As we expand our sales operation, there will be opportunities for high performers to take on greater responsibility.



### What Success Looks Like



We are not interested in activity for activity's sake.



Success means:



**Good prospects → quality conversations → qualified meetings → new customers.**



If you enjoy speaking to people, are comfortable picking up the phone, like working towards targets and want your earnings to increase with your performance, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Operations Assistant (Meta Ads)
description:

title: Tekla Draftsperson
description:
Traidie is recruiting an experienced Tekla Draftsperson to join a growing consultancy team delivering scaffold and temporary works designs for international construction projects.



This position is suited to a technically capable draftsperson who can create detailed 3D models and convert them into clear, accurate and professionally presented 2D construction drawings.



Essential requirement

You must have:

• At least three years of professional experience using Tekla Structures

• Examples of your own Tekla models and drawing output that you can confidently present and discuss



Please do not apply if you cannot demonstrate both of these requirements.



Previous scaffolding experience is not essential. However, you must already be a confident and experienced Tekla user. Training will be provided in scaffold design, ScaffPlan and the company’s internal standards, but not in the fundamentals of Tekla Structures.



What you’ll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

• Creating accurate 3D scaffold models using Tekla Structures and ScaffPlan

• Converting 3D models into clear and accurate 2D construction drawings

• Producing layouts, plans, sections, elevations, details and 3D views

• Preparing base-out dimensions and information required for scaffold installation

• Incorporating buildings, structures, equipment and site information into project models

• Working with architectural, structural, civil and mechanical reference models

• Coordinating IFC, DWG, DXF, PDF and point-cloud information where required

• Identifying clashes, missing information and potential constructability issues

• Producing material and equipment lists from completed models

• Revising models and drawings following internal reviews and engineering feedback

• Completing your own quality checks before submitting work for review

• Working with Australian designers, engineers and project managers

• Managing assigned work to meet agreed deadlines



What we’re looking for

To be considered, you must have:

• A minimum of three years’ professional Tekla Structures experience

• Strong 3D modelling and construction-documentation skills

• Proven experience converting 3D models into accurate 2D drawings

• Experience producing plans, sections, elevations and construction details

• A good understanding of construction drawings, dimensions, levels and structural geometry

• Strong spatial awareness and attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• The ability to understand written instructions, drawing mark-ups and verbal project briefings

• Good time-management and organisational skills

• Availability during agreed Australian business hours

• A reliable and accountable approach to your work



Highly regarded experience

The following would be an advantage but is not essential:

• Scaffold drafting or scaffold design

• ScaffPlan

• Temporary works or construction access systems

• Point clouds or laser-scanning data

• Australian construction or engineering projects

• IFC and CAD-reference coordination

• A qualification in drafting, BIM, engineering technology, construction or a related field



What you’ll receive

• Structured onboarding and technical guidance

• Training in ScaffPlan and scaffold-design workflows

• Exposure to varied international construction projects

• The opportunity to develop specialist scaffold and temporary-works knowledge

• Long-term professional development and increased project responsibility



How to apply

Apply at: 

Use referral code: JOSP260717



Please include:

• Your current CV

• Examples of your own Tekla work, including both 3D models and completed 2D drawings

• A short explanation of your involvement in each example

• Confirmation of how many years you have used Tekla Structures professionally



Applications without evidence of at least three years’ professional Tekla Structures experience will not progress.

title: VIDEO EDITOR (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES | PART-TIME)
description:
This Is NOT Just Another Editing Job



We are building something bigger than content. We are building a brand that dominates attention, builds trust instantly, and converts viewers into customers and clients across roofing, construction, and real estate.



If you are a high-level video editor who understands storytelling, pacing, and visual impact—and who knows how to leverage AI video tools to produce more, faster, without losing quality—keep reading.



Who We Are



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based company operating across roofing and construction, real estate and property development, and media and community-based platforms. We move fast. We execute. And we expect excellence.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented Video Editor (AI-Assisted) based in the Philippines who can create high-impact short-form and long-form content, generate and integrate AI-produced video, avatars, and B-roll into real client work, and turn raw footage into compelling, conversion-driven content. This is a part-time remote role, but performance-based growth opportunities are very real.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



First, you must be advanced in at least one major editing platform—CapCut at a high level, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro. If you are not highly proficient in editing software, this role is not for you.



Second, and this is a major factor for us, you must have hands-on, proven experience generating video and visual assets with AI tools. We are talking about Veo 3 for cinematic text-to-video, Seedance for AI video generation, HeyGen for avatars and talking heads, Higgsfield for motion control and ad creative, Nano Banana for image generation and editing, and comparable platforms like Runway, Kling, Sora, ElevenLabs, or Midjourney. We actively use these tools in production every day. If you have never generated AI video and worked it into a real edit, this role is not for you. Please include AI-generated samples in your portfolio and tell us which tool produced which shot.



Your Responsibilities



On the editing side, you will cut short-form content for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok, along with long-form pieces for YouTube, brand videos, and interviews. That includes clean transitions, captions and subtitles, motion graphics, and sound design.



On the AI side, you will write effective prompts that produce usable footage rather than impressive tests. You will generate AI B-roll, product and property visuals, and scene fillers where live footage does not exist. You will build AI avatar and voiceover content for ads, explainers, and localized versions. Most importantly, you will blend AI-generated footage seamlessly with real footage so it reads as intentional, not artificial—upscaling, reframing, and cleaning up output until it is genuinely usable. Over time, you will help us track what works and build repeatable AI workflows.



You will also handle supporting design work: thumbnails, social visuals, and branding elements, all consistent with our brand style.



What Makes You a Strong Candidate



You understand storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention. You can make content feel modern, clean, and premium. You know the difference between AI footage that sells and AI footage that looks fake. You have an eye for detail and composition, you are fast and responsive and reliable, and you can follow direction while still bringing your own creative ideas. You also stay current as new tools launch, because this space changes monthly.



It is a bonus if you have edited construction, real estate, or business content before, if you understand short-form viral trends, if you know how to edit for engagement and conversions, or if you have built and documented an AI content workflow.



Work Style Expectations



This is a fast-paced environment. Clear communication is required. Deadlines matter, and quality matters more. We are not looking for average—we are looking for someone who takes pride in producing top-tier work consistently, and who sees AI as a way to do more of it.



How to Apply



Send us your portfolio or reel, at least two examples of AI-generated video you personally produced along with the tools used, and a short note on which AI tools you reach for most and why.

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: Exceptional Virtual Assistant for Airbnb Business - 4PM - 11PM PST
description:
Night Shift Operations Coordinator

Vo Rental ("Vo Place Like Home") — Anaheim, CA



ABOUT US



Vo Rental owns and manages a portfolio of roughly 50 short-term rental and residential properties. The core of the business is in Orange County — Anaheim, Garden Grove, Westminster, Santa Ana, Midway City — with additional homes in Las Vegas, Panama City and Panama City Beach, FL, and Kissimmee, FL. We run a cleaning team of about 19 people and turn over homes every single day of the year.



Our day shift gets the houses cleaned. Our night shift gets the guests in the door and sets up tomorrow. This is the second half of that.



THE ROLE



You take the handoff from the day shift at 4 PM — right as guests start arriving — and you carry the business through the evening. You get every arriving guest into their home, you build and send out tomorrow's cleaning schedule, and you catch the late bookings that land after everyone else has signed off. When you finish your shift, tomorrow is already set up.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



Hours: 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time, US West Coast)

Days: Wednesday through Monday. Tuesdays off.

Pay: $1,000 per month



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Guest arrivals



Guests check in from 4 PM onward. Make sure every one of them gets into their home: door codes, gate codes, parking, wifi, directions

Handle arrival problems fast — a code that isn't working, a house that isn't ready yet, a guest arriving at midnight

Answer messages on Airbnb, 
, and direct channels through the evening

Approve or decline early check-in and late checkout requests



Tomorrow's cleaning schedule



Build the next day's cleaning assignments across a team of about 19 cleaners and balance the load fairly

Send each cleaner her schedule for tomorrow, along with any special instructions — guest counts, supplies to leave, promised early check-in times, long stays

Confirm every checkout tomorrow has a cleaner on it



Late bookings



Reservations come in all evening. When one lands for tomorrow or the same day, make sure a cleaner is assigned and actually told

Update the calendars so the morning shift starts from an accurate picture



Claims and documentation



Work through the damage reports and photo documentation queued up during the day

Organize photos, timestamps, and receipts into the supporting file

Keep the claims tracker current



Records and handoff



Log the day's cleaner assignments and any changes

Maintain calendars, task lists, and property records

Leave a clean handoff for the morning: what happened, what's outstanding, what to watch



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required



Fluent written and spoken English

Genuinely reliable with time. Guests arrive on a schedule and cleaners need tomorrow's assignments tonight — neither can wait.

Strong written communication — clear, short, warm messages to guests and to staff.

Calm under pressure. Most of what goes wrong in this business goes wrong in the evening, and you'll often be the only one on.

Comfortable working independently without being checked on.

Working knowledge of Google Calendar, Google Sheets or Excel, WhatsApp, and a shared task manager. You should be able to learn a property management system quickly.

Discretion. You will see guest information, addresses, access codes, and payment records.



Nice to have



Spanish. Much of our cleaning team communicates in Spanish, so it helps every day.

Prior short-term rental, property management, hospitality, or dispatch experience

Familiarity with Airbnb and 
 host tools

Experience coordinating field staff or contractors



Not required



A college degree

Prior experience with our specific software



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: You know the properties by name and can get any arriving guest into any house without help. You can build tomorrow's schedule with review.

First 60 days: The schedule goes out on time every night, correct, without anyone checking it. Guests get answers within minutes.

First 90 days: Nothing reaches the morning as a surprise. Late bookings are handled, cleaners know before they ask, and the handoff tells the day shift exactly what it needs.



TO APPLY



You must include a Loom video or a YouTube clip with your application. I will not entertain any proposal or applicant that does not include one.



In your video, introduce yourself and tell us about a time something went wrong late in the day and you had to solve it on your own — what happened, what you did, and how it turned out. Also confirm that you can work 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM PST, Wednesday through Monday.



You must spend at least 10 AP on this application, or it will not be reviewed.

ABOUT ME

Mom, surfer, party-lover, and teller of jokes. I help the world's biggest companies — and scrappy startups — make sense of their money as a fractional CFO (Big 4 alum, Berkeley & NYU MBA). Through Jane Eagle Consulting, I hire from a narrow pool — CPAs from top PH universities with Big 4 or large MNC experience — and place them with growing US clients. For this role, I'm the fractional CFO, so when I hire you, I'm hiring you onto a team I'm already on. If you've got high standards, want to learn from someone who's been in the seat, and still want a real life outside of work — let's talk.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accountant for our US-based fintech client (B2B payments technology). You'll report directly to the company's Controller and own the day-to-day accounting — AR, AP, and month-end close — for a growing, well-funded company.



This is a hands-on Senior Accountant seat, not a leadership role. You'll be in the books daily and partnering closely with the Controller, Customer Success, and engineering teams. There is real growth potential as the business scales.



The client moves fast and sets a high bar — you'll be doing real, meaningful work. The benefit of working with Jane Eagle Consulting: you have us in your corner. We mentor, advocate for you, and make sure you have what you need to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Generate and review monthly invoices in QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Identify and flag discrepancies; perform month-over-month variance analysis

• Verify subscription start dates for newly onboarded merchants

• Follow up with merchants on outstanding invoices and manage collections

• Partner with Customer Success on renewals validation

• Support ad hoc reporting on revenue and collections



Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Review incoming vendor invoices and categorize to appropriate expense accounts

General Bookkeeping & Month-End Close

• Maintain and execute the month-end checklist (accruals, prepaids, fixed assets)

• Record and reconcile bonus accruals, commission accruals, and payroll entries

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Manage fixed asset, depreciation, and amortization schedules

• Manage the company's virtual mailbox (Earth Class Mail)



WHO YOU NEED TO BE

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Philippines

• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy from a top Philippine university (Ateneo, UP, La Salle, UST, or equivalent)

• 4-8 years of accounting experience

• Big 4 audit experience (SGV/EY, Isla Lipana/PwC, KPMG, Deloitte) OR senior accounting experience at a large US/multinational corporation

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) — non-negotiable for this role

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling)

• Solid understanding of US GAAP

• Direct experience with full-cycle month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available during Pacific or Eastern Standard Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with subscription/SaaS revenue, recurring billing, or partner revenue share models

2. A short written note OR a short video — whichever you prefer — telling us about your professional background (especially your Big 4 or MNC experience and your most recent hands-on QuickBooks Online work), why you want this role specifically, and one thing most people would be surprised to learn about you

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.



APPLY HERE:

title: Exceptional Virtual Assistant for Airbnb Business - 8AM - 4PM PST
description:
Day Shift Operations Coordinator

**Vo Rental ("Vo Place Like Home") — Anaheim, CA**



About us



Vo Rental owns and manages a portfolio of roughly 50 short-term rental and residential properties. The core of the business is in Orange County — Anaheim, Garden Grove, Westminster, Santa Ana, Midway City — with additional homes in Las Vegas, Panama City and Panama City Beach, FL, and Kissimmee, FL. We run a cleaning team of about 19 people and turn over homes every single day of the year.



This is an operations job, not a desk job. Guests check out at 11 AM and the next guests walk in at 4 PM. Everything we do lives inside that window.



The role



You are the person who owns the turnover day. From the first checkout message to the last house cleared, you keep guests informed, cleaners moving, and every turnover finished on time. You work alongside our night-shift coordinator, who hands you the day and picks it back up when you sign off.



Schedule and pay



- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time, US West Coast)

- **Days:** Tuesday through Sunday. Mondays off.

- **Pay:** $1,200 per month



What you'll do



**Turnover and cleaner coordination**



- Monitor guest messages and confirm when guests have actually vacated each home

- Notify the assigned cleaner the moment her house is clear

- Build and balance the daily cleaning assignments across the team; reassign when someone calls out, a booking extends, or a house gets added late

- Send each cleaner her next-day schedule and any special instructions (guest counts, supply drops, promised early check-in times)

- Track that every checkout has a cleaner assigned and every clean is finished before check-in



**Guest communication**



- Answer guest questions on Airbnb, 
, and direct channels — access codes, parking, early check-in and late checkout requests, local recommendations

- Handle same-day problems: a lockout, a missing item, an AC that isn't cooling, a cleaner running behind

- Keep tone warm and responses fast; most of our reviews are won or lost here



**Damage claims and documentation**



- Collect and organize post-clean photo documentation from cleaners

- Intake damage reports: rename and timestamp photos, gather receipts, and assemble the supporting file

- Maintain the claims tracker and prepare claims for filing with Airbnb / 



**Maintenance and supplies**



- Dispatch and follow up on repairs, pest control, jacuzzi service, air filter changes, water heater flushes

- Track consumables per property and get restocks to the right house before the next cleaning

- Confirm work was actually completed, not just scheduled



**Records and reporting**



- Log cleaner hours and cleaning fees for monthly payouts

- Support month-end owner and tenant statements

- Keep the task list, calendars, and property records accurate — other people depend on them being right



What we're looking for



**Required**



- Fluent written and spoken English

- Genuinely reliable with time. This job is built on deadlines that cannot slip.

- Strong written communication — clear, short, warm messages to guests and to staff.

- Comfortable running your own day across many small moving pieces without being chased.

- Working knowledge of Google Calendar, Google Sheets or Excel, WhatsApp, and a shared task manager. You should be able to learn a property management system quickly.

- Discretion. You will see guest information, addresses, access codes, and payment records.



**Nice to have**



- Spanish. Much of our cleaning team communicates in Spanish, so it helps every day.

- Prior short-term rental, property management, hospitality, or dispatch experience

- Familiarity with Airbnb and 
 host tools

- Experience coordinating field staff or contractors



**Not required**



- A college degree

- Prior experience with our specific software



What success looks like



- **First 30 days:** You know the properties by name, you know which cleaner covers what, and you can run a turnover cycle start to finish with occasional help.

- **First 60 days:** Guests get answers within minutes. Cleaners hear from you before they have to ask. Nothing on the calendar surprises you.

- **First 90 days:** You catch problems before I do — the booking that extended, the house with no cleaner, the guest who is unhappy but hasn't said so yet.



To apply



**You must include a Loom video or a YouTube clip with your application. I will not entertain any proposal or applicant that does not include one.**



In your video, introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to fix a scheduling problem in real time — what went wrong, what you did, and how it turned out. Also confirm that you can work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST, Tuesday through Sunday.



You must spend at least 10 AP on this application, or it will not be reviewed.

About Us



Ylopo, LLC is a rapidly growing marketing and technology company providing internet marketing services and proprietary lead generation and engagement software to successful real estate agents across the country. We are seeking an outgoing, tech savvy individual to join our growing team.

a commitment to personal development,

title: CRO, Landing Page & Funnel Specialist
description:
CRO, Landing Page & Funnel Specialist



Remote – Philippines | 10–20 Hours/Week Initially → Expected to Grow

Base Pay: $4–$7 USD/hour DOE + Significant Performance Bonuses

Strong performers may earn approximately $8–$12+ USD/hour total compensation



Hunt Glass is a growing U.S. auto glass company building an all-star marketing team.



Our goal is to become the leading auto glass company in Utah, then expand nationally.



We are looking for an exceptional Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Landing Page & Funnel Specialist who can turn more of our traffic into customers and use marketing analytics to identify where we're making—or losing—money.



For the right person, this position has the potential to grow into a Marketing/Growth Manager role, helping coordinate our SEO, Google Ads, social advertising, and conversion efforts.



Our focus is:



Traffic → Qualified Lead → Scheduled Job → Completed Job → Revenue → Profit



What You'll Do



Build and optimize high-converting landing pages and funnels



Improve website conversion rates, calls-to-action, quote forms, and lead flows



Optimize the mobile customer experience



Run and analyze A/B tests



Identify where customers drop out of the funnel



Set up and improve conversion tracking and attribution



Track marketing source → lead → scheduled job → completed job → revenue/profit



Analyze results across SEO, Google Ads, Meta/social advertising, and other channels



Identify which campaigns, channels, pages, and markets produce the most profitable customers



Prepare a simple weekly marketing performance report



Identify the team's biggest growth opportunities and bottlenecks



Recommend where we should focus our marketing time and budget



Work closely with our SEO, Google Ads, social advertising, and sales team



Use AI extensively for analysis, testing, optimization, and productivity





Our website is currently built with Hostinger Horizons.



What We're Looking For



Proven CRO results



Proven experience with high-converting landing pages and funnels



Strong marketing analytics and conversion-tracking skills



Understanding of attribution and customer acquisition



Ability to connect marketing activity to customers, revenue, and profit



Ability to analyze multiple marketing channels and turn data into clear recommendations



Experience with U.S. local-service or lead-generation businesses strongly preferred



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills



Excellent organization and English



High proficiency using AI for marketing and analytics



Marketing leadership or team-coordination experience is a major plus





We care much more about measurable business results than attractive websites, clicks, traffic, or other vanity metrics.



Compensation & Growth



Base Pay: $4–$7 USD/hour DOE + significant performance bonuses



We want exceptional people to be rewarded for exceptional results. Someone producing outstanding measurable results may earn approximately $8–$12+ USD/hour total compensation.



This position will begin at approximately 10–20 hours/week and is expected to grow as Hunt Glass expands.



An exceptional person who demonstrates strong strategic thinking, leadership, and an ability to improve the entire marketing system may have the opportunity to become our Marketing/Growth Manager, with greater responsibility, hours, and compensation.



How to Apply



Please answer all 10 questions and number your answers.



1. How many years of professional experience do you have with CRO, landing pages, funnels, and marketing analytics?





2. Describe your best measurable conversion improvement. Include the starting result, ending result, timeframe, and exactly what you personally changed.





3. Describe another result where your work measurably increased leads, customers, revenue, ROAS, or profit.





4. Provide examples of landing pages, funnels, websites, dashboards, or conversion projects you've personally worked on.





5. Describe your experience with conversion tracking, attribution, analytics, and connecting marketing sources to actual customers and revenue.





6. Rate your AI proficiency from 1–10. Which AI tools do you use, what do you use them for, and how have they improved your work?





7. Hunt Glass generates leads from SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Maps, but we don't know which source produces the most profitable customers. How would you build a system to determine this?





8. Imagine Meta has the lowest cost per lead, while Google Ads costs more per lead but produces a much higher percentage of completed jobs. Meanwhile, website conversion has declined. What information would you examine, what conclusions might you draw, and what would you recommend we do next?





9. What hourly base rate are you requesting?





10. How many hours/week are you currently available, and are you interested in eventually increasing your hours and potentially growing into a Marketing/Growth Manager role?







You may use AI to help organize or improve your application. However, all experience, results, examples, and claims must be your own and accurate. We may ask finalists to demonstrate or verify their work.



We care much more about measurable results, analytical ability, and your ability to improve profitability than certificates or job titles.

title: Video Reel Editor
description:
Real Estate Video & Reels Editor



I’m looking for an experienced **video editor who specializes in real estate media and short-form reels**.



I have a large ongoing real estate content series where I appear on camera discussing and ranking homes and properties I have worked on. There are currently **350+ homes/videos**, with more being added regularly.



 What You’ll Be Editing



1. Real Estate Ranking Series



I will be creating a large series of short-form videos where I talk directly to the camera and give rankings/reviews of real estate homes I have photographed or filmed.



These videos need to be edited in a **high-energy, attention-grabbing style**, including:



* Captions/subtitles

* Fast-paced cuts and transitions

* Strong timing and pacing

* Removing unnecessary pauses and dead space

* Visual effects when appropriate

* Emphasis on important words or moments

* Editing that keeps the viewer engaged from beginning to end

* Clean, professional real estate presentation

* Following my exact editing instructions and style



There will be **353+ videos**, so I am looking for someone who can handle a large volume of content while maintaining consistent quality.



2. Real Estate Media Reels



I also regularly create real estate media reels.



For these, I will provide you with a **reference video** and expect you to recreate the editing style as closely as possible using the footage and resources available to you.



The goal is not simply to make something that looks "similar."



**I need you to replicate the reference video as closely as possible.**



That includes the:



* Pacing

* Cuts

* Transitions

* Text/captions

* Timing

* Effects

* Music/sound design

* Overall visual style

* Flow and structure



3. IMPORTANT — Editing Test



Before being hired, you will be given a video and specific instructions for an editing test.



**The test will be unpaid.**



This is intentional because I need to see whether you can actually execute the editing style and follow detailed instructions before committing to a long-term working relationship.



If you are not comfortable completing a free test edit, **please do not apply.**



4. Requirements



You **must**:



* Have experience editing real estate media

* Have strong short-form/Reels editing experience

* Understand modern social media pacing

* Be highly proficient with captions and fast-paced editing

* Be able to replicate a reference video accurately

* Follow detailed instructions without improvising when exact replication is requested

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Be fluent in English

* Be able to clearly understand what is being said in the videos

* Be able to communicate effectively in English

* Be comfortable handling a large volume of videos

* Consistently meet deadlines

* Have examples/portfolio work that demonstrates your abilities



6. Please Do NOT Apply If:



* You cannot follow exact editing instructions

* You cannot understand spoken English in the videos

* You are not fluent enough in English to understand the content and instructions

* You are unable to replicate a reference video

* You are not experienced with real estate media

* You are not comfortable completing the required unpaid test edit

* You only do basic cuts and captions and cannot create fast-paced, professional reels



7. Long-Term Opportunity

description:

Viral Coach helps businesses increase company visibility and brand presence with organic social media, paid ads, and other digital marketing strategies. Our team includes social media experts with tenure on marketing teams for leading brands including Amazon, Paypal, NerdWallet, and others. High standards, fast pace, zero drama. We win by making clients win.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Viral Coach is seeking a talented, detail oriented Operations Associate to help execute on a variety of vital tasks managing client data, databases and other operational resources as needed. We are looking for a motivated, self-starter with a good grasp on data entry and data management best practices using tools such as Google Sheets and Airtable. Exceptional at communicating responsively using Slack.



You like efficient processes, good data, and spreadsheets. You ask questions, but are comfortable making decisions on sometimes incomplete information, using context. You often go above what is expected of you, identifying ways to improve procedures and streamline tasks.



RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS:

Complete data entry tasks and database updates in a timely fashion

Perform internet research to locate social media profiles to complete data entry tasks

Communicate progress and escalate issues to appropriate people

Good working knowledge of data best practices

Strong competence with spreadsheets (Google Sheets and/or Excel)

Able to handle large data sets and make connections 

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Speed and clarity in communication (primarily in Slack)

Willing to work in a fast-paced environment with an openness to change

2+ years of relevant experience in administrative/operations tasks

Assist with special projects and tasks as assigned



Core Values



Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.



Competitive Greatness



Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect, and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.



Sincere Candor



Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.



Unimpeachable Character



Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.



Compensation



Compensation for this role starts at $4-8 USD per hour depending on location and experience, with room to grow based on performance. This position is hourly and we expect to provide 35 to 40 hours of tasks per week. In this position you will be asked to maintain and submit a bi-weekly timesheet.



Schedule



The schedule is flexible. Many of the tasks you will perform in this role can be done asynchronously and do not require you to work our exact schedule, however we require at least some small overlap with our core business hours (10 to 6pm, Monday - Friday PST) in order to provide updates and hand off tasks. title: Consumer Law Paralegal – FCRA/FDCPA
description:
# Consumer Law Paralegal – FCRA/FDCPA



We are looking for a detail-oriented part-time paralegal/legal assistant located in the Philippines to assist with organizing and preparing consumer credit and debt-related case files.



Our work involves credit reporting issues, debt collection matters, and potential claims involving the **Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)** and **Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA).**



Responsibilities will include:



* Review credit reports, dispute results, creditor responses, collection letters, and supporting documents

* Identify and organize inconsistencies in credit reporting

* Build detailed timelines of disputes, responses, and continued reporting

* Organize evidence and supporting documentation for potential cases

* Research FCRA and FDCPA statutes, court cases, and consumer-law issues

* Prepare factual case summaries for review

* Assist with drafting templates, demand letters, dispute documentation, chronologies, and case packets

* Research creditors, debt collectors, credit bureaus, registered agents, and arbitration provisions

* Maintain organized client case folders and tracking spreadsheets

* Assist with preparing documents for attorney review, arbitration, or potential pro se litigation when requested

* Track deadlines, correspondence, certified mail, dispute dates, investigation results, and supporting evidence



Experience with **U.S. consumer law, FCRA, FDCPA, credit reporting, debt collection, litigation support, PACER, or arbitration is strongly preferred.**



The ideal candidate is extremely organized, understands confidentiality, can research independently, and knows the difference between documenting a potential legal issue and providing legal advice.



This position is for legal research, administrative support, document preparation, and case organization. The paralegal will not independently provide legal advice to clients or represent clients in legal proceedings.



Please include any previous experience involving FCRA, FDCPA, credit reporting, debt collection, consumer law, arbitration, or U.S. litigation support when applying.

Litigation & Case Preparation

Assist with preparing draft FCRA/FDCPA complaints, demand letters, pre-litigation notices, arbitration demands, and other litigation documents using approved templates and client-specific facts.

Organize complaints into sections such as Parties, Jurisdiction, Statement of Facts, Causes of Action, Damages, and Requested Relief.

Prepare and label supporting exhibits, including credit reports, dispute letters, bureau responses, creditor correspondence, certified-mail records, denial letters, and other evidence.

Research defendants, registered agents, court information, arbitration provisions, and relevant FCRA/FDCPA statutes and case law.

Build a detailed chronology for each potential case showing what happened, when it happened, who was notified, and how the reporting or collection activity continued.

Prepare draft documents for attorney or client review before anything is signed or filed.

Maintain case-status trackers for demand, settlement, arbitration, and litigation matters.



This role does not provide independent legal advice, determine which claims a client should file, sign pleadings, represent clients, or file legal documents on a client’s behalf unless permitted and properly supervised by licensed counsel.

I'm looking for someone who can become my behind-the-scenes support person — keeping my content pipeline full, finding new product opportunities, communicating with brands, managing Creator Connections, and helping distribute the content I create.



My goal is to spend more of my time filming and creating, while you help keep everything moving behind the scenes.



I'm specifically looking for someone who already has experience with the Amazon Influencer ecosystem and can work independently with minimal training.



This will start as a part-time position with the opportunity to grow into a larger, long-term role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Your biggest priorities will be:



Researching products that would be a good fit for my Amazon Storefront and audience

Finding brands and Amazon sellers to contact for product samples

Sending approved brand/sample outreach

Following up with brands and tracking responses

Helping coordinate product samples

Researching Amazon Creator Connections campaigns

Identifying strong Creator Connections opportunities

Keeping product, sample, campaign, and content tracking organized



Additional responsibilities may include:



Uploading and managing Amazon Influencer videos

Cross-posting completed content to YouTube and Pinterest

Basic CapCut video editing

Creating simple thumbnails in Canva

Writing basic video titles/descriptions

General administrative support related to my content business



MUST-HAVES

Previous experience working with an Amazon Influencer

Familiarity with Amazon Influencer Storefronts

Experience with Amazon Creator Connections

Experience with product research and/or brand outreach

Strong written English — C1/C2 English preferred

Excellent attention to detail

Organized and able to manage multiple ongoing tasks

Able to work independently without needing step-by-step instruction for standard Amazon Influencer tasks

Reliable communication

Fast, reliable internet

Comfortable receiving feedback and applying it moving forward

Interested in a long-term working relationship



Experience with the following is a plus:



ViralVue

Securing product samples for Amazon Influencers

CapCut

Canva

YouTube

Pinterest

Google Drive



SCHEDULE



Approximately 5–8 hours per week to start.



I am located in California (Pacific Time), but you do not need to work U.S. hours. Most tasks can be completed asynchronously.



Some availability for occasional communication during overlapping hours is helpful.



There is potential for increased hours as the business grows.



COMPENSATION



Starting rate: $5 USD/hour



This position will begin with a 30-day paid trial period.



If we're a good fit, my goal is to continue working together long-term and increase hours and responsibilities as the business grows.



Payment will be made twice per month via [Wise / Payoneer].



TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with the word:



MATCHA



Applications without this word will not be considered.



Please include the following:



Portfolio link (With videos you've edited in CapCut, ideally with UGC examples)

Confirmation that you meet every must-have above

How many hours per day you can commit to

How long have you worked with Amazon Influencers?

Describe the specific tasks you handled for your previous Amazon Influencer client(s).



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with me and become a trusted part of my content business long-term.

title: Entry Landscape Draftsman (2D / 3D / Rendering) – International Projects
description:
*Please do not apply if you're not very familiar with the Landscape Design Space.



We’re looking for a Junior Landscape Draftsman who can support our local team with 2D drafting, 3D modeling, and rendering for international landscape projects (US, AU, UK, and more). 



You’ll work closely with senior designers and project leads to turn concepts into clear, buildable drawings and compelling visuals. If you love landscape design, are detail-oriented, and want daily exposure to global standards, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

 • Prepare 2D landscape drawings (plans, elevations, sections, details) using CAD software.

 • Build 3D landscape models (e.g., SketchUp or similar) based on design briefs and CAD files.

 • Produce high-quality renders and presentation images for client submissions.

 • Update and revise drawings based on markups, redlines, and feedback from senior staff.

 • Assist in organizing drawing sets for tender, construction, and presentation purposes.

 • Maintain clean file structures, layer standards, and naming conventions.

 • Coordinate with project managers to meet deadlines across different time zones.



Qualifications

 • 1–3 years of experience as a Landscape Draftsman, CAD Technician, or similar role

(Strong fresh grads with solid portfolios are welcome to apply).

 • Proficiency in 2D CAD (AutoCAD or similar).

 • Working knowledge of 3D modeling (preferably SketchUp).

 • Experience in rendering (Lumion, D5, Enscape, V-Ray, or similar) is a big plus.

 • Basic understanding of:

 • Landscape / site plans

 • Planting plans

 • Hardscape layouts

 • Levels / grading and details

 • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow standards and templates.

 • Comfortable working with foreign clients and communicating in English (written and spoken).

 • Willingness to learn fast, receive feedback, and grow into a more senior role over time.



Compensation, Credits & Growth

 • Starting (Probationary): P20,000/month 

 • With good performance, salary can grow to P30,000/month and higher



We use a Credit Policy System to measure and reward:

 • Output & Quality – accuracy of drawings, clarity, reduced revisions

 • Speed & Reliability – hitting deadlines, responsiveness

 • Dedication – consistency, ownership, and professionalism

 • Long-Term Contribution – staying, improving, and helping the team grow



Important:

Salary is directly correlated with your Credit score in our system.

Higher credits = higher salary and opportunities.



What We Offer

 • Work on international landscape projects with growing long-term clients.

 • Training and mentoring to help you level up your skills.

 • Clear path from Junior to Mid / Senior Draftsman.

 • Remote work setup with performance-based incentives and bonuses.

 • A merit-based environment where your growth depends on your effort and results.

Excellent written communication and attention to detail

Reliable internet connection and ability to work EST hours full-time



Strongly Preferred



? BuilderTrend or Procore experience

Proactive — you flag issues before they become problems

Performance Bonus

title: Sales Representative

This is not a customer service role.

You prospect.

You follow up.

You run demos.

You close.

Earn 50% of the onboarding fee

Current onboarding fee is $1,000 per business unit

Current commission is $500 per business unit

Paid after onboarding is completed

What You Will Do:

Build targeted prospect lists using SO Good tools and approved sources

Work and grow a lead database of 3,000+ prospects

Complete 75 to 100+ outbound touches per day

Cold call,
, text, and send DMs

Follow up consistently across every stage

Qualify prospects based on pain, budget, authority, and timing

Run 45 to 60-minute demos with local business owners

Explain rankings, visibility, and revenue opportunities clearly

Handle objections and skepticism

Close deals

Competitive

Persistent

Comfortable hearing "no"

Strong in spoken and written English

Experience selling to local or home-service businesses

Google Business Profile or SEO knowledge

Google Sheets or CRM experience

Loom experience

Remote Work Requirements

You can work from home, but you must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A quiet and professional workspace

Reliable computer and headset

Strong English communication skills

Stable availability during your scheduled working hours

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Facelove Cosmetics is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer beauty brand built for women over 40, with a strong presence across the US and EU markets. 



The Role



We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own end-to-end hiring for our e-commerce and creative functions — from writing job descriptions through sourcing, screening, and offer coordination. You'll work closely with our HR Manager and hiring stakeholders to keep our contractor and full-time pipelines full of strong, vetted candidates.



This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a coordination-only role. You'll be expected to source proactively, run structured screens, and bring sharp judgment to who's actually a fit — not just who looks good on paper.



What You'll Do



Manage full-cycle recruitment for e-commerce (media buying, growth, ops) and creative (design, video, content, strategy) roles

Write and refine job descriptions that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones

Source candidates proactively through LinkedIn, job boards, and other channels — not just wait for inbound applicants

Screen resumes and portfolios, run initial interviews, and produce structured, comparable candidate assessments for hiring managers

Coordinate interview scheduling across time zones with hiring managers and founders

Draft and help negotiate offers, and support onboarding handoff for new hires

Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in our hiring systems (GoHire, LinkedIn Recruiter)

Flag pipeline or spec issues early — if a role's requirements are producing no viable candidates, bring evidence and options rather than continuing to source blindly

Spot resume and portfolio red flags (inflated experience, reused/scraped creative work, unverifiable claims) before they reach final interviews



What You'll Need



3+ years of recruitment experience, with a track record hiring specifically for e-commerce and creative roles

Experience recruiting for DTC or performance-marketing-driven companies is a strong plus

Comfortable evaluating creative portfolios (design, video, content) as well as more traditional e-commerce/ops backgrounds

Strong sourcing skills — you don't just post and pray

Excellent written communication; you can write both a sharp JD and a warm, human candidate

Ability to work core hours aligned to CET

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-moving environment

Experience with hiring/ATS tools such as GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter is a plus



How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You'd rather be corrected than be wrong for a quarter

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

description:

We continuously develop new products and solutions to help our customers stay competitive and respond quickly to changing market trends.



Having recently celebrated our 10th anniversary, we are actively expanding our global presence. We are now looking for a Global Recruiter to support the growth of our international teams, with a particular focus on commercial and business-related roles across Europe, the US and Asia.

- Support employer branding activities and help improve how Printbelle presents itself to international candidates

- Track recruitment progress, candidate pipelines and key hiring metrics

- Conduct market research on salary levels, talent availability and hiring trends in different countries

- Continuously improve recruitment processes to make hiring faster, more structured and more effective



Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology or a related field is preferred

- At least 3 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition or executive search, preferably in an international environment

- Experience recruiting for commercial roles such as Sales, Business Development, Account Management or Marketing is a strong advantage

- Strong sourcing skills, particularly through LinkedIn and other international recruitment platforms

- International experience gained through work, education or employment at a global company is highly preferred

- Strong understanding of western communication styles, business culture and candidate expectations

- Strong written and spoken English

- Able to work independently, take ownership and stay productive in a fully remote environment

- Strong communication, interviewing and relationship-building skills

- Goal-oriented, organised and able to manage multiple open positions at the same time

- Proactive, resourceful and comfortable actively approaching passive candidates

- Willing and able to maintain reasonable working-hours overlap with European business hours

- An above-market competitive salary package

- A fully remote position with the flexibility to structure your own working day

- Direct collaboration with our Global Commercial Lead, HR team and international hiring managers

- Exposure to recruitment across Europe, the US and Asia
