title: Guest Communications & Marketing Specialist
description:
About us 



Luxury Mountain Destinations manages approximately 150 vacation homes in Park City, Utah — ski-in/ski-out properties in Deer Valley, homes near Park City Mountain, and a growing summer business built on hiking, biking, and the Utah backcountry. 



We're in the middle of a deliberate shift: moving more of our bookings away from the online travel sites and onto our own website. About half our business comes direct today. We want it to be sixty percent. 



We are building a small, senior offshore team — not a call center seat. You will be one of two people we're hiring in the Philippines this year. You and your counterpart will share the guest communications and reservations desk between you on staggered shifts, and each of you brings a second discipline to the team. Yours is marketing. 



This is a genuine two-sided role. Half your week is guests and reservations. The other half is marketing. Both halves matter and we staff, schedule, and measure them separately. 



 



An unusual note about experience 



You do not need vacation rental experience. We will teach you that half of the job. 



Guest communications and reservations are learnable, and we would rather train someone sharp, well-educated, and genuinely good with people than hire someone who already knows a different company's way of doing things. We have a structured six-to-eight week training program and we expect to use all of it. 



What we cannot teach is a real marketing foundation, exceptional English written and spoken, and composure with a demanding guest. Bring those and we'll handle the rest. 



 



What you'll do 



Guest communications and reservations — 50% of your time 



Voice (roughly half of this half). You'll take inbound reservation calls through our phone system. Someone calls asking about a five-bedroom home over Presidents' Week — you find out what they actually need, walk them through the right properties, quote it, and book it. You'll also take service calls from guests already in a home. 



Online. Inquiries and messages by
, text, and through online websites (eg Airbnb). Pre-arrival questions: arrival instructions, ski storage, parking, altitude tips, restaurant recommendations. In-stay issues — triage, enter tickets for and/or route to our Park City operations and maintenance team, follow up until the guest confirms it's resolved. Post-stay follow-up. 



Reservations administration. Modifications, cancellations, ancillary sales, date changes, and payment processing in our property management system and change requests in 3rd party systems (eg Airbnb). 



Reason-coding. Every inquiry that doesn't book gets a reason — price, dates unavailable, wrong property type, no hot tub, too far from the lift. Every time. This is one of the most valuable things you'll do and almost nobody in our industry does it. 



Marketing — 40% of your time 



Note: this role does not manage social media. That sits elsewhere. Your marketing work is direct-booking and owner acquisition demand, content, and lifecycle — the things that move guests from the travel sites onto our own site and bring them back – and the things that compel property owners to complete an introductory call with our Business Development team. 



Guest marketing 



Lifecycle
. Write and schedule campaigns in our CRM — shoulder-season pushes, repeat-guest offers, peak-week announcements, win-back sequences. Build and maintain the segments behind them. 



Property listing content. Write and maintain descriptions, amenity detail, and photo captions on our direct website. Our listings should be the best-written ones a guest sees that day, and there are 150 of them. 



Destination content and SEO. Local guides, seasonal landing pages, on-page SEO. Someone searching "Deer Valley ski-in rental" should find us. 



Direct-booking conversion. Landing pages, promotions and packages, booking-flow copy, and the offers that make booking direct obviously better than booking through an OTA. 



Owner marketing 



Owner communications. Newsletters, market updates, seasonal outlooks, and program announcements to the homeowners whose properties we manage. These are how an owner decides we're an asset manager rather than a booking agent. 



Owner acquisition. Nurture campaigns to prospective homeowners, realtor and broker referral outreach, and the market-report content that gets a second-home owner to call us instead of a competitor. 



Paid media 



Google Ads. Build, run, and optimize search campaigns against a monthly budget. Report on cost per booking, not clicks. 



Meta ads. Paid
 and Instagram campaigns for guest demand and owner acquisition, including audience building and creative iteration. 



Direct mail. Postcard and print campaigns to guest and owner lists — list segmentation, copy, coordination with the print vendor, and tracking what came back. 



 



Property onboarding 



When a new home joins the portfolio, you launch it: write the listing, coordinate photography needs, get it live and consistent across our site and every channel, and run the announcement campaign that gets it booked in its first season. A new property that sits unbooked for two months is a very unhappy owner. 



Reputation and reporting 



Reputation. Respond to public reviews across channels in our brand voice, and flag patterns worth fixing operationally. 



Reporting. Campaign performance, ad spend and return, direct vs. OTA mix, inquiry-to-booking conversion, owner-lead volume. Tell us what's working and what to stop doing. 



 



The advantage you have over any marketer we could hire separately is that you're on the phone and in the inbox every day. You'll hear what guests actually ask, in their own words, before you write a single subject line — and you'll know what they asked for that we don't have. 



Making it better — 10% 



Turn the questions guests ask most into templates, FAQ content, and listing improvements. Cover your teammate's desk during their time off and peak weeks — you are each other's backup. 



 



What we're looking for you to bring 



Education 



Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, Multimedia Arts, English, or Business Administration. This is the one hard credential requirement. 



Certifications in Google Analytics or Google Ads are a plus but not required. 



Experience 



2+ years in marketing, content, copywriting, or communications. Enough that campaign work, a CMS, and a reporting dashboard are familiar territory rather than concepts from a textbook. 



Language — this is the highest bar in the posting 



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, easily understood accent. You will be on the phone with American guests spending thousands of dollars a week. We assess this on a live call. 



Exceptional written English. Not "good" — exceptional. You'll write copy representing a luxury brand and messages that resolve problems for demanding guests. Writing samples required. 



Foundation 



A portfolio: campaigns, listings, landing pages, articles, or long-form writing you actually wrote. 



Hands-on with an
 platform and a CMS. 



Comfort with numbers — you can read a campaign report or a booking pace report and say something useful about it. 



SEO fundamentals: keywords, on-page structure, why a page ranks or doesn't. 



Disposition 



Composure. When a guest is upset at 8 PM about a cold hot tub, you stay calm and useful. 



Coachability. We are going to teach you an industry. You need to take feedback well and get better fast. 



Curiosity about a place you've never been. This matters more than it sounds like it does. 



Self-directed. We don't use time-tracking software and we don't micromanage. We need someone who doesn't require either. 



Setup 



Wired internet, 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up minimum, with a backup connection. 



A quiet, enclosed room — this is a voice role and background noise is disqualifying. 



A UPS or backup power plan for storm season (June–November). 



A quality headset. We'll reimburse it. 



A real plus, though not required 



Vacation rental, short-term rental, hotel, resort, or travel/hospitality marketing experience. If you've written listings, run a hotel's
 program, or marketed a destination, say so prominently. 



Vacation rental software: Streamline, Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Track, Hospitable. 



BPO or call center experience on a U.S. voice account. 



Basic design in Canva. 



Comfort with AI tools — we use them daily and expect you to. We'll also expect you to know when the output sounds like AI and to fix it. 



 



Schedule 



This role works U.S. Mountain Time hours. Park City is 14–15 hours behind the Philippines, so your working day will fall outside standard Philippine business hours — overnight or early morning, depending on the shift. A shift differential applies. 



We staff this desk with two people on staggered shifts, so that between them we cover our full guest day and our busiest check-in days have two people on. Which shift and which days you take depends on the pair we hire and on how demand moves through the year, and schedules can change with reasonable notice. Expect some weekend coverage. We confirm your exact hours and days before you start. 



The U.S. observes daylight saving time and the Philippines does not, so the Mountain Time equivalent shifts by one hour in March and November. We adjust the Philippine-time schedule so your hours stay consistent. 



 



Compensation 



$1,200 USD per month. 



13th month pay. 



15 days (3 weeks) paid time off per year, plus Philippine regular holidays. 



$25 monthly internet and power allowance. 



Headset reimbursement. 



Shift differential. 



Performance bonus tied to direct-booking conversion. And/or owners that progress to sales call 



Annual performance and salary review. 



We pay on time, every time, and we're looking for someone who wants this to be a career, not a stopover. 



 



What's hard about this job 



The guests are wealthy and their expectations are high. When something goes wrong at 8 PM in a $4M house, you're the first person they talk to, and "I'll look into it" is not an answer they accept gracefully. 



Park City is a place you've probably never been. You'll need to learn a mountain town's geography, seasons, and rhythms well enough to advise someone on where to stay and what to do — from the Philippines. If that sounds tedious rather than interesting, this isn't your role. 



And the job asks you to switch between two modes: the interrupt-driven phone and inbox, and focused creative work. We protect the second on your calendar, but you have to be someone who can make that switch cleanly. 



 



How to apply 



Start your application with the word POWDER so we know you read this. 



Send us: 



A short note (under 300 words): your marketing education and background, and where you've dealt with customers, clients, or the public directly. 



Your resume, plus 2–3 writing samples. 



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing a place you love, as if you were recommending it to someone who's never been. Any format. This is required — we assess spoken English early because it's the hardest thing to teach. 



Write a 150-word description for a five-bedroom ski-in/ski-out home in Deer Valley with a private hot tub, a bunk room, and a view of Bald Mountain. Make us want to book it. 



Applications missing the keyword, the voice recording, or #4 will not be reviewed. 



Process: short screening call → work sample (campaign subject lines, a review response, two written guest messages, and a mock reservation call after we give you a property fact sheet) → final video interview with our leadership team. 



Luxury Mountain Destinations is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on demonstrated ability.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant

About BBG

BBG (formerly Bermuda Bulk Gases and Tools & Equipment Unlimited) supplies industrial and medical gases, hydraulic hose assemblies and industrial products throughout Bermuda.

We’re building on a long history while investing in the future. Under new leadership, we’re strengthening our people, systems and technology to build an organisation designed to become stronger over time.



The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to work closely with the Executive and become an important part of how their work gets done.

Your role is to help the Executive use their time and attention more effectively. You’ll provide administrative support across both business and personal matters, helping organise their time, information, communication and commitments.

You’ll work closely with the Executive and Chief of Staff, take responsibility for important details and continually look for ways to make the Executive more effective.



What You’ll Do

You’ll help the Executive use their time and attention effectively by:

Managing their calendar, scheduling, travel and other logistics.

Managing correspondence and helping prepare and draft communications.

Organising business and personal administrative matters.

Keeping track of commitments, requests and follow-ups.

Preparing, reviewing and organising documents and information.

Anticipating needs and handling routine matters without unnecessary involvement from the Executive.

Supporting the Chief of Staff with administrative execution.

As you develop your understanding of the Executive and the organisation, you’ll increasingly recognise what requires the Executive’s attention, what can be handled independently and how to make the best use of their time.



Who We’re Looking For

You have strong character. You’re trustworthy, discreet and understand the responsibility that comes with having access to confidential business and personal information.

You’re exceptionally dependable and organised. You follow through on commitments, communicate when plans change and make sure important details don’t get dropped.

You’re proactive and exercise judgement. You anticipate needs, recognise what you can handle independently and know when something requires the Executive’s attention.

You communicate clearly and professionally and make information easy for others to understand and act on.

You have a love of learning. You ask questions, learn from experience and continually look for ways to become more effective.

You’re comfortable using technology and AI to improve the way you work.



Technical Foundation

You should have:

Experience supporting a busy executive or business owner.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organisational and administrative skills.

Experience using modern productivity software.

The following experience is highly desirable:

Managing complex calendars, travel and executive logistics.

Drafting correspondence and working with confidential information.

Working in a remote or distributed team.

Using AI and automation to improve the way you work.



Compensation & Benefits

Competitive compensation.

Ongoing training and development.

Opportunities for increased responsibility and career progression.

The opportunity to build a long-term career with BBG.



Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to help both you and BBG confirm whether we’re likely to be a strong long-term fit.

The process will include an application, online assessment, short video response, interviews and a practical assessment.

title: Online Fitness Coaching Assistant (Everfit)
description:
About us

SR FitWell is a personal training business in Perth, Western Australia, run by Scott Richmond out of Snap Fitness Yanchep. We coach around 30 clients, a mix of in-person and online. Most are everyday people, not athletes. Shift workers, mine workers, mums, blokes in their forties getting back into it.



We are small and we intend to stay personal. Every client is known by name. That matters for this role, because you will get to know them too.



We are in Perth, which is the same timezone as the Philippines. No overnight shifts, no working while we sleep. When you are online, we are online.

The role

Scott handles the in-person coaching. What he does not have time to do properly is the online side, and that is where you come in.



You will own the weekly rhythm of our online coaching inside Everfit. Reading what clients have logged, updating their programs, keeping their nutrition targets current, and flagging anyone who is drifting before they disappear.



This is not general admin. You need to genuinely understand training and nutrition, because you will be looking at a client's week and d
 what needs to change.



You will not be inventing our method. We have written it all down. Our programming rules, our nutrition approach and our client templates are documented and you will be trained on them. Your job is to apply that system consistently, week in and week out, and to tell Scott when something needs his judgement.



What you will do each week



Review every active client's Everfit dashboard and note who is on track and who is not

Read the weekly check-in forms clients submit each Saturday and summarise what matters

Update and progress workout programs in Everfit in line with our documented method

Keep macro and nutrition targets current as clients' weight and goals change

Assign the next block of workouts before a client's current program runs out

Flag anyone who has gone quiet, missed sessions, or stalled, so Scott can call them

Keep client folders and records tidy and up to date

Prepare a short weekly summary for Scott every Sunday morning so he knows where everyone is at

Escalate anything involving injury, illness, pregnancy, medication or anything outside our normal system straight to Scott, never handle it yourself

What we need from you

Solid working knowledge of resistance training. You should know what progressive overload is, why rest periods matter, and how to structure a training week without being walked through it

A genuine understanding of macros and calories. You should be comfortable with protein targets per kilogram of bodyweight and be able to spot when a number looks wrong

Excellent written English. You will be reading what clients write about their week and summarising it accurately for Scott

Reliable. This is a weekly rhythm and it has to happen every week without being chased

Comfortable saying "I am not sure, can you check this" rather than guessing. We would much rather that

Stable internet and a computer that can run Everfit in a browser without trouble



Nice to have, but we will train you

Experience with Everfit specifically. If you have used Trainerize, TrueCoach, PT Distinction or similar, that transfers fine

A fitness qualification of any kind

Experience working with Australian or other English speaking clients

Canva

Hours and schedule

Around 10 to 15 hours per week to start, spread across the week however suits you, with two fixed commitments:



Saturday evening or Sunday early morning to review check-ins as they come in

Sunday morning to have the weekly summary ready for Scott



There is genuine scope to grow this into full time as we take on more online clients.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. We read every one properly and we can tell.



Send us:



Put the word BARBELL at the start of your subject line so we know you read this properly

A short note about your experience with fitness coaching or training, and which coaching platforms you have used

Answer this question in two or three sentences: A client has trained all four of their sessions every week for a month, they are logging their food accurately, and their weight has not moved at all. What are the first three things you would check?

Tell us your internet speed and whether you have a backup if it drops out



We will reply to everyone who follows the above. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a short-paid test task using a real anonymized client example, then a video call with Scott

title: Legal & Medical Case Coordination Virtual Assistant
description:
Position Description



(Virtual) Legal & Medical Administrative Assistant



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Employment Type: Ongoing Contract (Part-Time, with opportunity to increase hours)



Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week initially



Time Zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time (preferred)



About the Role



We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Legal & Medical Administrative Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative, case coordination and document preparation support across complex client matters.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant role. You will become the central point of coordination for matters involving healthcare providers, legal representatives, government agencies, insurers and community organisations. You will manage day-to-day administration, coordinate stakeholders, prepare professional documentation, track deadlines and ensure matters progress efficiently.



A key component of this role involves supporting clients through legal and administrative appeal processes. You will assist in preparing appeal documentation, organising supporting evidence, maintaining comprehensive case files and ensuring submissions are complete, accurate and lodged within required timeframes. While you will assist with drafting and document preparation, all final legal and professional decisions will remain with the supervising professional.

The successful candidate will be capable of working independently, anticipating needs, solving problems proactively and producing work of a consistently high professional standard.



Resilience & Professional Boundaries



This role involves supporting clients who may experience complex mental health conditions, including trauma-related presentations. At times, interactions may involve heightened emotions, frustration or challenging communication.



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



- Emotional resilience and the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate respectfully and effectively in challenging situations.

- The confidence to maintain professional boundaries while providing compassionate, client-centred support.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to de-escalate conversations through clear, calm and respectful communication.

- The ability to remain organised and focused when managing sensitive or high-pressure matters.

- A commitment to treating all clients with dignity, empathy and professionalism, while recognising when to seek guidance or escalate concerns appropriately.

- Experience working with clients experiencing trauma, PTSD, mental health conditions, or within healthcare, legal, veterans' services, disability, or community services will be highly regarded.



Key Responsibilities



Executive & Administrative Support



- Manage calendars, appointments and scheduling.

- Coordinate meetings with clients, healthcare providers, legal representatives and external stakeholders.

- Manage
 correspondence and inbox organisation where delegated.

- Prepare agendas, meeting minutes and action registers.

- Maintain digital filing systems and ensure document version control.

- Prepare and submit administrative forms and applications.

- Develop and improve administrative systems and workflows.

- Assist with general business administration as required.



Case Coordination



- Coordinate complex client matters involving multiple stakeholders.

- Liaise with healthcare professionals, allied health providers, government departments, insurers and legal representatives.

- Monitor outstanding reports, referrals and assessments.

- Follow up practitioners regarding outstanding documentation.

- Maintain detailed case timelines and evidence registers.

- Track review dates, tribunal deadlines and key milestones.

- Identify risks, delays and outstanding actions requiring escalation.

- Ensure all case documentation remains organised, current and audit-ready.



Legal Appeals & Case Support



- Assist in preparing legal and administrative appeal documentation.

- Compile, organise and index supporting evidence for appeals and reviews.

- Prepare document bundles and supporting schedules for submission.

- Maintain detailed chronologies and timelines of key events.

- Monitor appeal deadlines and ensure all documentation is prepared on time.

- Liaise with client, legal representatives and practitioners to obtain supporting documentation.

- Assist in drafting correspondence relating to appeal matters.

- Prepare case summaries and briefing documents for review.

- Maintain confidential records relating to legal and administrative proceedings.



Document Preparation & Professional Writing



- Prepare first drafts of professional reports, submissions and correspondence.

- Draft letters to healthcare providers, government departments, insurers and legal representatives.

- Compile evidence into structured reports and case summaries.

- Develop chronological timelines of significant events.

- Prepare executive summaries and briefing documents.

- Edit, proofread and professionally format documentation.

- Convert meeting notes, voice recordings and handwritten notes into polished documents.

- Conduct research to support document preparation where required.

- Prepare presentation materials and information packs.



Research & Information Gathering (Discovery)



- Conduct research into legislation, policies, government programs and healthcare systems (across Australia, and Philippines).

- Source relevant evidence to support client matters.

- Review and summarise medical reports and supporting documentation.

- Prepare research summaries and briefing papers.

- Monitor changes to relevant legislation, funding pathways and administrative processes.



Project & Workflow Management



- Develop and maintain project plans and task trackers.

- Monitor workload priorities and upcoming deadlines.

- Coordinate multiple concurrent matters.

- Maintain action registers and ensure timely follow-up.

- Recommend improvements to systems and processes.

- Assist in implementing efficient workflows across the business.



Document & Records Management



- Organise electronic files and maintain structured document libraries.

- Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information.

- Maintain naming conventions and document control processes.

- Prepare document bundles for meetings, submissions and reviews.

- Archive completed matters in accordance with organisational procedures.



Essential Skills & Experience



Applicants should possess:



- Minimum three years' experience in one or more of the following:

- Legal Assistant

- Medical Administration

- Administrative Assistant

- Case Management

- Paralegal

- Virtual Assistant

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Outstanding attention to detail.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Excellent problem-solving skills.

- High level of professionalism and discretion.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

- Experience with cloud-based document management systems.

- Knowledge of legal governance and policy within Australia and the Philippines.

- Demonstrated emotional resilience and the ability to communicate professionally and effectively in emotionally demanding or high-pressure environments.

- Applicants must be current residents of the Philippines and available to work during Australian business (AEST) hours.



Highly Desirable



- Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

- Australian legal administration.

- Australian healthcare administration.

- Philippine legal administration.

- Appeals, tribunal or litigation support.

- Government agency correspondence.

- DVA, NDIS or workers' compensation administration.

- Medical terminology.

- Project coordination.

- Productivity software.



Personal Attributes



- The successful candidate will be:

- Exceptionally organised.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Calm under pressure.

- Able to think critically and solve problems independently.

- Highly reliable and accountable.

- Professionally presented in written communication.

- Comfortable managing confidential and sensitive information.

- Resourceful and adaptable.

- Committed to producing work of a consistently high standard.



Technology Requirements



Applicants should have:



- Reliable high-speed internet.

- Dual-monitor workstation (preferred).

- Modern computer capable of running Microsoft Office and cloud-based software.

- Professional home office environment suitable for confidential work.



Performance Expectations



Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to:



- Independently manage day-to-day administration.

- Coordinate appointments and stakeholder communications efficiently.

- Maintain accurate case files, timelines and evidence registers.

- Produce high-quality drafts of reports, submissions and correspondence requiring minimal editing.

- Assist in preparing organised and complete legal and administrative appeal documentation.

- Ensure no deadlines are missed through proactive task management.

- Improve administrative systems and workflow efficiency.

- Become the primary administrative point of contact for assigned matters.



Remuneration



- Competitive remuneration will be offered based on experience, qualifications and demonstrated capability.



How to Apply



Please submit:



- Your current resume.

- A cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

- Examples of professional writing (reports, correspondence, submissions or administrative documents, where appropriate).

- Your expected hourly rate AU.

- Your weekly daily availability.

- Your notice period (if applicable).

- Details of any experience in legal, medical, government or administrative support.



Only applicants with excellent written English, exceptional organisational skills and relevant legal, medical or administrative experience will be shortlisted. Successful candidates will also be required to do a National Police Check.

title: Online Arbitrage Product Research VA — Leads Only, No Purchasing
description:
Description:

We're an active Amazon FBA seller doing online arbitrage, looking for an experienced researcher to find profitable deals from retail websites and submit them as vetted leads. This is a research and lead-generation role only — you will not purchase inventory or handle company funds; the seller makes every buying decision and executes every order. You'll work from a defined scorecard (provided) — this is not an entry-level role, and we're not training OA from scratch.



Responsibilities:

- Source deals daily from retail sites (Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Walgreens, and others we'll assign) using Keepa and SellerAmp

- Score every candidate against our scorecard: margin, ROI, BSR, velocity, gating, and IP risk

- Submit each qualifying lead with a direct link to the retailer listing and full supporting data — no purchasing required or expected

- Track leads in a shared spreadsheet with full supporting data

- Flag gated brands/categories and known IP-complaint risk before submitting, not after

- Submit a daily or twice-weekly batch of leads that already pass our minimum bar



Requirements:

Prior hands-on online arbitrage research experience — please apply only if you've sourced OA leads before

Proficiency with Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

Understanding of sales rank/BSR, gating, and IP complaint risk

Strong attention to detail — accuracy on margin/ROI numbers matters since we buy based on your research

Reliable internet, comfortable with Google Sheets, available for daily check-ins



Pay & Hours:

Starting pay is $3/hr, there will be a two week trial period before hiring to see if you are the right fit for us.



Put "DEAL HUNTER" as the first word of your reply so we know you read this fully. Include: (1) 2–3 examples of past leads you sourced and why they qualified, (2) which tools (Keepa, SellerAmp, others) you have active subscriptions to right now, (3) a 60-second video intro.

-Has previous cold calling and/or sales experience

In the recording, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following:

title: Marketing Operations & Project Coordinator
description:
Marketing Operations & Project Coordinator

Part-Time | Remote | 20 Hours/Week | Long-Term Opportunity

About the Role

We help smart, self-aware singles break unconscious patterns and find the love they actually want.

I'm a relationship coach, author, speaker, and founder of an established transformational coaching company. We are in an exciting growth phase with workshops, digital programs, live events, newsletters, Substack, social media, and a new brand and website.

I'm looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive Marketing Operations & Project Coordinator who can help turn ideas and plans into completed projects.



This is NOT a traditional Virtual Assistant role.

I do not need someone who waits for me to create a list of tasks every day.

I need someone who sees the plan, understands the desired outcome, creates and manages the tasks, executes much of the implementation, follows up on what is missing, and makes sure things actually get DONE.

I already have our ClickUp structure and project templates built. You will not be starting from scratch. Your job is to help me run the system consistently and execute the work.

What You'll Own

Project Management & ClickUp

Manage our existing ClickUp project plans and templates

Take a launch/event date and work backward to establish deadlines

Create and maintain tasks, subtasks, owners, due dates, and dependencies

Make sure every project has a clear plan BEFORE execution begins

Follow up on overdue or blocked tasks

Identify missing pieces before they become emergencies

Keep projects moving without requiring me to constantly check in

Turn decisions made during meetings into organized tasks and next steps

Give me a concise list of anything that specifically requires my decision or approval

GoHighLevel / Funnels / Marketing Technology

Build and edit landing pages in GoHighLevel

Create forms and registration pages

Load and schedule
 and SMS campaigns

Build basic automations and workflows

Test registration and follow-up sequences before they go live

Maintain tags, contacts, and basic CRM organization

Make sure workshop/event leads receive the correct follow-up

Help maintain simple sales and marketing funnels

, Newsletter & Substack Implementation

Format and load completed newsletter copy

Format and publish Substack articles and posts

Add links, images, CTAs, and formatting

Schedule
s

Proofread for obvious mistakes before publishing

Test links and pages

Repurpose approved content when appropriate

You will not be expected to be the primary copywriter. Strong writing and editing skills are a plus, but your primary responsibility is implementation and execution.

Social Media & Canva

Create clean, attractive Canva graphics using our existing branding and templates

Resize graphics for different platforms

Turn supplied content into simple social media assets

Schedule and publish approved posts across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other platforms

Repurpose existing content, videos, and stories

Maintain a consistent publishing schedule

Organize photos, videos, and content assets so they are easy to find

You do NOT need to be a high-end graphic designer. You DO need a good eye and the ability to make professional-looking content in Canva.

The Kind of Person I'm Looking For

You are someone who thinks:

"I see what needs to happen. Let me figure this out and move it forward."

Not: "Tell me exactly what to do next."



You should be:

Extremely organized

Proactive and resourceful

Comfortable taking ownership

Detail-oriented without losing sight of the goal

Excellent at following through

Comfortable learning new technology

Able to troubleshoot before immediately asking for help

A clear communicator

Comfortable respectfully following up with other team members

Able to distinguish between something you can solve yourself and something that genuinely requires the founder

Excited about creating systems and making things run smoothly



I value ownership, integrity, kindness, communication, and reliability.

Required Skills

Please apply only if you have strong experience with several of the following:

ClickUp or comparable project management software

GoHighLevel

Canva

 marketing

Landing page and funnel building

Social media scheduling and posting

CRM management

Google Workspace

Online launches, workshops, webinars, or digital marketing

GoHighLevel + ClickUp experience is especially valuable. If you are excellent at marketing operations and project coordination but have not used one particular tool, I am open to someone who learns technology extremely quickly.

Hours & Compensation

Approximately 20 hours per week to start

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Remote

Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required

Target compensation: $12-$20 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level

I care much more about finding the right person than the cheapest person. If you are exceptional and can truly take ownership, there is room to grow with the company.

How to Apply

Please do NOT send a generic cover letter.

Start your application with the words: LOVE READY



Then answer these questions:

1. Tell me about a project or launch you personally managed from beginning to end. What did YOU own?

2. What is your experience with ClickUp? Have you created and managed project plans, dependencies, recurring tasks, and deadlines?

3. What have you personally built inside GoHighLevel? Please be specific.

4. Can you build a simple landing page, form,
/SMS automation, and follow-up workflow yourself?

5. What is your Canva experience? Please share examples of graphics or marketing materials you have personally created.

6. Which social media platforms have you personally managed and posted to?

7. Imagine this situation: We held a workshop on Sunday. It is now Tuesday morning. There are 40 new leads, and you discover that nobody received the promised follow-up
 or SMS. I am unavailable in meetings until noon. What would you do? Please walk me through exactly how you would handle it.

8. Imagine I tell you: "Our next workshop is October 7. The ClickUp launch template already exists." What are the first things you would do?

9. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

10. What hourly rate are you seeking?

Paid Finalist Test

Final candidates will be invited to complete a small paid skills test. The test may include:

Working from a sample ClickUp project template

Organizing a small launch

Creating a basic Canva graphic

Demonstrating how you would build a simple GoHighLevel landing page and follow-up sequence

Responding to a real-world project management scenario

This is not a test of who can give the "perfect" answer. I want to see how you think, organize, communicate, solve problems, and take ownership.

This Role Is Probably NOT For You If...

You need detailed instructions for every task

You regularly wait for someone to remind you about deadlines

You are uncomfortable following up with people

You only want to do administrative work

You only do social media and do not enjoy operations

You consider a task complete without checking that the final result actually works

You are uncomfortable troubleshooting technology

This Role MAY Be Perfect For You If...

You love taking a creative entrepreneur's vision and turning it into an organized plan, and then making sure that plan becomes reality. You enjoy both thinking AND doing. You can open ClickUp in the morning, understand what needs attention, move projects forward, execute marketing tasks, follow up with people, solve problems, and give the founder back her time to focus on the work only she can do.



If that sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: QuickBooks Online Certified Bookkeeper – US GAAP Month-End Close (Part-Time to Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Role



Atma Group is a growing CFO advisory firm serving founder-led US businesses ($5M–$100M revenue) — we provide the kind of investor-grade financial leadership normally reserved for private equity-backed companies. As we scale, we're building out our offshore accounting bench and looking for an experienced, QuickBooks Online (QBO) Certified bookkeeper to own the month-end close process for our US SMB clients. This is not a data-entry role — we need someone who understands GAAP-based accrual accounting, can independently drive a close from trial balance to finalized financials, and takes ownership of accuracy and timeliness. This is a great opportunity to grow with a firm scaling its offshore accounting operations from the ground up.



What You'll Do



Perform full month-end close in QuickBooks Online for multiple US SMB clients

Develop, maintain, and follow a standardized month-end close checklist (account reconciliations, accruals, prepaids, depreciation, AR/AP cutoffs, etc.)

Reconcile bank, credit card, and balance sheet accounts to zero variance

Prepare accurate, GAAP-compliant financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

Identify and correct discrepancies, miscoded transactions, and out-of-balance entries

Maintain clean, audit-ready books that support downstream financial reporting and analysis

Communicate close status, blockers, and questions proactively — we need someone who flags issues, not just files them away



Requirements



QuickBooks Online Certified (ProAdvisor) — required, please note certification in your application

Several+ years of hands-on bookkeeping/accounting experience specifically for US-based small businesses

Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, particularly accrual accounting concepts

Demonstrated experience running a structured month-end close process (not just categorizing transactions)

Excellent written English communication — you'll be working directly with US-based team members and occasionally clients

Highly organized, detail-obsessed, and comfortable working independently against a checklist and deadline

Reliable internet and a distraction-free home office setup



Nice to Have



Experience with multiple concurrent clients/entities

Familiarity with tools like Bill.com, Gusto, or similar SMB finance stack apps

Prior experience working for a US accounting/CFO advisory firm or bookkeeping agency



Schedule & Logistics



Part-time to start (10 hrs/week), with strong potential to move to full-time after a probationary period based on performance

Rate: $5–$10/hour to start, commensurate with experience and certification — reviewed at full-time transition

Remote, with US time zone overlap required for at least a few hours daily



To Apply



Please include: (1) your QBO certification, (2) years of experience with US-based clients specifically, and (3) 3 professional references (name, relationship, and contact info).

title: Digital Content & Authority Manager for U.S. Law Firm
description:
Looking for a smart, resourceful Digital Content & Authority Manager to help build the online presence of an experienced family law attorney in Boca Raton, Florida.

This is not a typical social media posting job.

We are looking for someone who can help establish an experienced attorney as a credible authority across:

Legal directories

LinkedIn

Google



Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

X/Twitter

Online publications

AI-powered search such as ChatGPT, Google AI/Gemini and Perplexity

The goal is not maximum followers or maximum leads.

The goal is to build credibility, attract attention and generate high-quality prospective clients.



About the Attorney

Barbra Amron Weisberg is a Boca Raton, Florida family law attorney with more than 30 years of legal experience.

She represents clients in Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade Counties.

Her practice increasingly focuses on sophisticated matters involving:

Complex divorce

High-net-worth/financially significant divorce

Business owners and executives

Closely held businesses

Business valuation

Forensic accounting

Significant investments and real estate

Executive compensation

Equitable distribution

Alimony

Contested parenting/time-sharing matters

Family law litigation



Barbra is a solo practitioner, not a large law firm.

This is important to our positioning.

She offers experienced, personal attorney involvement and does not want a high-volume practice.

We are not trying to generate hundreds of low-quality leads.

We want prospective clients who have meaningful cases requiring sophisticated legal work and who have the financial ability to retain experienced counsel.



Think: Quality over quantity. Authority over advertising.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

The position has three primary responsibilities.

1. Legal & Professional Profiles

You will audit, claim, update and complete Barbra's profiles on important legal and professional platforms.

Examples include:

Justia

Martindale-Hubbell

Lawyers.com

Avvo

FindLaw

Google Business Profile

Bing Places

Apple Business Connect/Maps

LinkedIn

Other reputable legal directories

You will make sure information is complete and consistent, including:

Biography

Practice areas

Experience

Education

Professional history

Contact information

Photos

FAQs

Articles

Published appellate opinions

Links

Other available profile fields

We want strong, complete profiles—not simply directory listings.

You will also help identify inaccurate, duplicate or outdated information about Barbra online.



2. Social Media Management

Help build and manage a sophisticated professional presence across appropriate platforms.

Priority will likely include:

LinkedIn



Instagram

YouTube

TikTok

with selective use of X/Twitter and other platforms when worthwhile.

You should be able to:

Create posts

Create Canva graphics/carousels

Repurpose existing content

Schedule posts

Create short-form video/story content

Edit simple videos

Develop content calendars

Track performance

Identify topics receiving engagement

Recommend what we should do more or less of

We do NOT want generic daily posts just to fill a calendar.



3. Content & Authority Building

This is the most important and creative part of the position.

Barbra has 30+ years of real legal experience and many interesting stories from cases she has handled.

We want to turn that knowledge into compelling content.

For example:

“I once handled a divorce where...”

“The tax return said one thing. The business records told a very different story.”

“What happens when someone says the company they own isn't worth anything?”

“Can your spouse hide income inside a business?”

“Why $1 million in a retirement account isn't necessarily the same as $1 million in cash.”

The objective is to combine interesting stories with useful legal education.

All client stories must be appropriately anonymized and approved by Barbra before publication.

ONE IDEA SHOULD CREATE MANY PIECES OF CONTENT

We want someone who understands efficient content repurposing.

For example, we may interview Barbra for 30–60 minutes about one or two subjects.

From that material, you should be able to create:

A substantive article or Q&A

LinkedIn posts


 posts

Instagram carousel

Instagram/Facebook Reel

TikTok concept

YouTube Short or narrated story

X/Twitter posts

FAQs

Potential external article or media pitch

Create once. Repurpose intelligently.

VIDEO WITHOUT REQUIRING BARBRA TO BE ON CAMERA CONSTANTLY

Barbra is not particularly interested in becoming a traditional on-camera social media personality.

We are therefore interested in creative alternatives.

Examples:

Narrated case stories

Text/graphic videos

Animated explainers

Voice-over videos

Short story videos

Tasteful stock/B-roll combined with narration

Occasional Barbra appearances

Turning written stories into compelling short-form video

If you have experience doing this, please show us examples.

Do not use AI-generated versions of Barbra's face or voice without our express permission.

AI SEARCH / AEO / GEO

An important part of this project is increasing Barbra's authority and discoverability in AI-powered search as well as traditional Google search.

We want content that clearly and accurately establishes relationships such as:

Barbra Amron Weisberg

→ Boca Raton family law attorney

→ 30+ years experience

→ complex divorce

→ high-net-worth divorce

→ business owners and executives

→ sophisticated financial divorce matters

→ Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade Counties

You should understand—or be willing to learn—concepts involving:

SEO

AEO

GEO

Entity consistency

Author authority

Third-party citations

Structured Q&A content

Content repurposing

Digital PR

Backlinks from legitimate sources

AI-search visibility

We are NOT interested in spam backlinks, keyword stuffing or outdated SEO tricks.

THIRD-PARTY EXPOSURE

Over time, we also want help identifying legitimate opportunities for Barbra to appear outside her own website and social accounts.

Examples:

Guest articles

Legal publications

South Florida publications

Business publications

Podcasts

Journalist requests

Expert commentary

Interviews

Collaborations with CPAs

Wealth managers

Forensic accountants

Business valuation professionals

Other attorneys and professional referral sources

The goal is to create independent authority and credibility, not simply more posts on Barbra's own accounts.

IMPORTANT: THIS IS A HIGH-END PROFESSIONAL BRAND

Our market is Boca Raton and South Florida.

The content should look appropriate for clients involving significant:

Businesses

Professional practices

Investments

Real estate

Retirement assets

Executive compensation

Income

Marital estates

We do not want cheesy lawyer advertising.

Avoid:

Excessive emojis

Cheap-looking graphics

Constant "CALL NOW!" messages

Generic stock photos of gavels

Fake courtroom images

Clickbait

Claims that Barbra is "the best"

Guaranteed outcomes

Generic AI-generated legal articles

The desired impression is:

This attorney has been practicing for more than 30 years, handles sophisticated matters, personally knows her cases, and knows what she is doing.



USE OF AI

We encourage intelligent use of ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve efficiency.

However:

AI should make you faster. It should not replace judgment.

You may use AI for:

Brainstorming

First drafts

Repurposing

Research assistance

Headlines

Social variations

Transcription

Content organization

Video concepts

You may NOT simply generate legal content with AI and publish it.

Anything explaining Florida law must be reviewed and approved by Barbra before publication.

Anything based upon an actual case must also be approved before publication.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal person is:

An excellent English writer

Highly organized

Resourceful

Comfortable with AI tools

Experienced with social media

Comfortable with Canva

Able to perform online research

Familiar with SEO

Interested in AEO/GEO and AI search

Capable of managing multiple online profiles

Able to turn complicated subjects into interesting content

Detail-oriented

Comfortable working independently

Able to accept feedback and revise quickly

Experience with U.S. law firms, attorneys, financial services or other professional-service businesses is a major plus.

Perfect U.S. English is important.

HOURS AND COMPENSATION

This will begin as a part-time position of approximately 15–20 hours per week.

For OnlineJobs.ph, we anticipate approximately:

$8–$12 USD/hour depending upon experience, with the possibility of a monthly arrangement after we establish the workload.

We are willing to pay more for someone exceptional who has demonstrated U.S. legal/professional-services experience.

For Upwork, please propose your hourly rate or fixed monthly fee.

We care much more about quality and productivity than hours worked.



There is potential for this to become a long-term position.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application.

Begin your application with: QUALITY OVER QUANTITY

This lets us know you actually read the posting.

Then answer these five questions:

1. If you had only 15 hours per week to build Barbra's online authority and generate higher-quality family law inquiries, what would you prioritize during your first 60 days? Keep your answer to approximately 300 words or less.

2. Tell us about any work you have done for U.S. attorneys, law firms, financial professionals or other sophisticated professional-service businesses. Provide links/examples if available.

3. Explain your experience with SEO, AEO/GEO and AI-powered search. If you don't have direct AEO/GEO experience but understand the concepts and want to learn, say so. Do not exaggerate your experience.

4. What tools do you use?

For example:

ChatGPT

Claude

Canva

CapCut

Adobe

Hootsuite

Buffer

Metricool

Semrush

Ahrefs

Google Analytics

Google Search Console

Other tools

5. What compensation would you require for approximately 15–20 hours per week?

Please provide your desired hourly rate and/or monthly compensation.



We don't need thousands of leads. We want the right clients to find her.

title: Marketing Admin Assistant
description:
Marketing Admin Assistant (Freelance, ~20 hrs/week) — Canva, Marketing, Multi-Client Support



Summary

Marketing Admin

- Freelance / Contract — Remote, US Hours

- Location: Remote (Overseas welcome)

- Type: Freelance / Contract — ~20 hours/week, with potential to grow to 25

- Compensation: Depends on experience. -90 day trial + pay bump after 90 days. 

- Schedule: Minimum 5 dedicated hours per day, Monday–Friday, overlapping U.S. Mountain Time business hours



About Us



Elle Marketing and Events is a full-service, boutique marketing agency that builds unforgettable brands and experiences. We're based in Salt Lake City and work with clients across the U.S. — restaurants, hospitality groups, nonprofits, and growing businesses with a story worth telling. We believe in storytelling rooted in strategy and results. Our team is women-led, collaborative, kind, and held to a high standard — and we take care of each other the same way we take care of our clients.

We're looking for a Marketing Admin to become a trusted, behind-the-scenes engine of our team. This is a real freelance role for someone who loves variety, manages their time like a pro, and brings a genuine can-do attitude every single day.



What You'll Do



- You'll be the connective tissue between our strategists, copywriters, designers, social media managers, and account team. 

On any given day, you might be:



- Running spelling and grammar review on blog posts using Grammarly

- Writing and assembling
 and SMS campaigns in MailChimp and Constant Contact

- Drafting basic copy for
s, text messages, and short-form social content

- Building on-brand graphics in Canva using existing client templates (and occasionally creating new ones)

- Light Adobe Illustrator work — you don't need to be an expert, but you should know your way around

- Uploading press releases and managing basic distribution

- Posting last-minute social content during U.S. business hours when our overseas social media managers aren't online

- Reading a client's marketing strategy and executing against it without hand-holding

- Managing tasks for many different clients at the same time inside Teamwork (our project management tool)

- Communicating clearly and proactively with the team about timelines, blockers, and progress

- Jumping in with general marketing support whenever a teammate asks for an extra set of hands



This role touches a lot of clients and a lot of moving parts. The right person genuinely enjoys that kind of variety — and knows how to stay calm and organized inside it.



What a Day Looks Like



Every day is a little different — that's the nature of agency life — but here's a realistic snapshot of how a typical workday might unfold:



- Morning (start of your shift): You log in, check Teamwork, and review the day's task list across your assigned clients. You see a blog post that needs a Grammarly pass before it goes live, two
 campaigns to assemble in MailChimp, and a new Canva graphic request from the social media team. You message the team in your morning check-in to confirm priorities.

- Mid-morning: You knock out the Grammarly reviews and send the blogs back to the copywriter with notes. You start assembling the first
 blast in MailChimp — pulling copy from the project doc, sourcing images from the client's brand folder, and following the template setup the strategist outlined. 

- Around lunchtime: A social media manager pings you. A scheduled Instagram post for a restaurant client needs to come down right now — there's been a menu change. You handle it, message the account manager so she knows, and document the change in Teamwork.

- After lunch: You build three Canva graphics for an upcoming
 campaign using the client's existing template, upload a press release for a nonprofit client, and finish the second
 blast assembly. You spot a broken link in the
 — flag it, fix it, and move on.

- End of day: You update your tasks in Teamwork, leave clear notes on anything that's still in progress, and log off knowing the team has exactly what they need to pick up where you left off tomorrow.

- The right person finishes a day like this feeling energized — not drained — by the variety.



What You Bring



- The ability to multitask across multiple clients and brands without losing your footing. This is the most important skill for the role.

- Strong independent problem-solving. When something unexpected lands on your plate, you think it through, propose a solution, and move — without needing every step spelled out for you.

- Excellent time management and team communication. You hit deadlines, you give clear updates, and you ask the right questions early.

- Fluent, professional English — written and verbal. The role is rarely client-facing, but would require attendance at weekly internal meetings via zoom. 

- Availability for at least 5 dedicated hours per day, Monday through Friday, during U.S. Mountain Time business hours



Working proficiency in:



- Canva (template-based design and light original work)

- Adobe Illustrator (basics)

- MailChimp and Constant Contact

- Grammarly

- Teamwork (or comparable project management tool — Asana, ClickUp, Monday)

-
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile

- A solid grasp of marketing strategy fundamentals — you can read a strategy doc and know what to do with it

- A strong design eye — your Canva work should look polished, on-brand, and intentional

- Trustworthiness, reliability, and discretion — you'll be working inside client accounts and handling sensitive information



Bonus Points If You Have

- Past agency experience supporting multiple clients at once

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients

- Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, or basic press release distribution platforms

- Experience writing for hospitality, restaurant, or lifestyle brands

- A love for marketing strategy and creative problem-solving



What Success Looks Like



- Tasks across many clients are delivered accurately, on time, and on brand

- The team can hand you something at 9 a.m. and trust it'll be done well by the deadline

- You catch the small things — typos, broken links, off-brand colors — before anyone else has to

- You communicate proactively and ask thoughtful questions when something isn't clear

- You become someone the whole team looks for first when they need backup



How to Apply

- We're reading carefully and looking for the right person, not the fastest applicant. To be considered, please include all four of the following:

- A cover letter telling us about your freelance experience, the kinds of clients you've supported, and why this role is a fit

- A writing sample — a short piece of marketing copy you've written (an
, social caption, or blog excerpt is great)

- A Canva design sample — share a link to a piece of work you designed in Canva, template-based or original



Brief answers to these screening questions:

- Walk us through how you'd handle three client requests landing in your inbox at the same time, all marked urgent. How do you decide what gets done first, and how do you communicate that to the team?

- You're given a one-page marketing strategy for a new client and asked to draft their first
 blast. What's your process from "open the doc" to "ready for review"?

- Tell us about a time something went sideways on a project — a missed deadline, a misunderstanding, a last-minute change — and how you handled it.



Applications missing any of the four items above won't be reviewed.



Working With Elle Marketing



We're a team of creative thinkers and strategic marketers who care deeply about our work, our clients, and each other. You'll enjoy this role if you thrive on variety, take real pride in being organized, and find genuine satisfaction in being the person who quietly keeps everything moving.

If that sounds like you — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Amazon Wholesale Catalog Analyst & Supplier Sourcing VA
description:
SOV Retail Group is looking for an experienced Amazon Wholesale Catalog Analyst & Supplier Sourcing Virtual Assistant.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who has previously worked with an Amazon Wholesale business, can analyze distributor catalogs, identify viable purchasing opportunities, source legitimate suppliers, and contribute practical experience to improve our operation.



The selected candidate will work directly with the company owners.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. WHOLESALE CATALOG ANALYSIS



• Clean and organize distributor and manufacturer catalogs.

• Match supplier SKUs, model numbers and UPCs to the correct Amazon ASINs.

• Detect incorrect matches, variations, sizes, bundles and multipack differences.

• Review Keepa price, Buy Box and sales-rank history.

• Evaluate price stability, seller count, competition and Amazon’s presence on the listing.

• Estimate monthly sales and the realistic sales allocation available to our company.

• Calculate referral fees, FBA fees, preparation costs, inbound shipping, net profit, ROI and margin.

• Review minimum order quantities, case packs, availability, MAP and marketplace restrictions.

• Flag products involving hazmat, expiration dates, meltable inventory, oversized dimensions or other operational risks.

• Classify every analyzed product as BUY, TEST, WATCH or REJECT.

• Explain the reasoning behind every recommendation.

• Present the final shortlist in a clear and accurate Google Sheet.



A profitable calculator result alone does not make a product a good opportunity. The analysis must consider price history, demand, competition, seller behavior, Amazon presence, restrictions, inventory risk and all relevant costs.



2. SUPPLIER SOURCING AND ACCOUNT OPENING



• Research legitimate U.S. distributors and manufacturers.

• Verify whether suppliers accept e-commerce and Amazon resellers.

• Identify brands, product categories, territories, minimum orders and account requirements.

• Locate wholesale applications and relevant contacts.

• Complete account applications using approved company information.

• Contact suppliers professionally by
 and telephone.

• Request catalogs, price lists, terms, MAP policies and e-commerce policies.

• Follow up on applications and unanswered communications.

• Record every supplier, contact, response, document, status and next action in our Google Sheets supplier CRM.

• Provide a weekly report showing leads, applications, approvals, rejections, follow-ups, analyzed catalogs and blockers.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• At least one year of experience working with an Amazon Wholesale business.

• Previous experience analyzing wholesale distributor or manufacturer catalogs.

• Practical experience matching UPCs and supplier products to ASINs.

• Ability to interpret Keepa charts, not simply read current values.

• Experience calculating net profit, ROI and profit margin.

• Understanding of Amazon referral fees and FBA fulfillment fees.

• Understanding of SKU, UPC, ASIN, FNSKU, MOQ, case pack, MAP and MSRP.

• Strong Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills.

• Strong spoken and written English.

• Experience communicating with U.S. suppliers by
 and telephone.

• Ability to explain why a product should or should not be purchased.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Experience limited to Online Arbitrage or Retail Arbitrage does not qualify as wholesale catalog-analysis experience.



PREFERRED TOOLS



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



• Keepa

• Amazon Seller Central

• SellerAmp

• SmartScout

• InventoryLab

• Sellerboard

• SellerSnap

• Scan Unlimited, Analyzer.Tools or similar bulk catalog-analysis software



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Part-time: 20 hours per week.

• Monday through Friday, approximately four hours per day.

• At least two hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Starting compensation: US$7–US$8 per hour based on demonstrated experience.

• Paid practical assessment for finalists.

• Paid two-week trial period.

• Performance and compensation review after 60 days.

• Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities based on performance.



EXPECTED CONTRIBUTION



We do not want someone who only copies information or depends entirely on automated software.



We want someone who can:



• Explain why a supplier is or is not worth pursuing.

• Identify false-positive products in catalog scans.

• Recognize missing costs and risks before recommending inventory.

• Explain what Keepa is showing and defend a purchasing recommendation.

• Share processes that worked for a previous Amazon Wholesale employer.

• Recommend practical improvements to our supplier and catalog workflow.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the subject line of your application with:



CATALOG 2026



Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed.



Answer all the following questions:



1. Describe your most recent Amazon Wholesale role and the exact tasks you performed.

2. How many years of Amazon Wholesale experience do you have?

3. Describe the largest wholesale catalog you analyzed and approximately how many products it contained.

4. Explain your process for converting a supplier catalog into a shortlist of potential products.

5. Which tools have you used for catalog analysis?

6. What information do you examine in Keepa before recommending a purchase?

7. How do you match a supplier product to the correct ASIN when the UPC is missing or incorrect?

8. How do you detect a single-unit versus multipack mismatch?

9. Explain the difference between ROI, profit margin and net profit.

10. Describe a product that appeared profitable but that you rejected after completing your analysis.

11. How did you find and qualify distributors for your previous employer?

12. Approximately how many wholesale accounts did you help open?

13. Are you comfortable calling U.S. suppliers in English?

14. What hours can you work in U.S. Eastern Time?

15. Confirm whether you accept US$7–US$8 per hour for 20 hours per week.



Also include:



• A link to a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your Amazon Wholesale experience.

• A sanitized example of a wholesale catalog analysis you previously completed, if available. Remove all confidential information.

• A list of the Amazon and catalog-analysis tools you have personally used.



SELECTION PROCESS



Applicants will pass through the following stages:



1. Application and experience review.

2. English voice-recording review.

3. Interview and live Keepa questions.

4. Paid practical catalog-analysis assessment.

5. Paid two-week working trial.



During the paid assessment, finalists will analyze a sample wholesale catalog and provide:



• Correct product and ASIN matches.

• Keepa observations.

• Estimated demand and competition.

• Amazon fees and operating costs.

• Net profit, ROI and margin.

• Risks or restrictions.

• A BUY, TEST, WATCH or REJECT recommendation.

• A written explanation supporting each decision.



Candidates must be able to explain and defend their analysis. Generic, copied or fully AI-generated applications will not be considered.



This role can become a stable, long-term position for someone who is accurate, reliable, proactive and capable of contributing real Amazon Wholesale experience.

 and LinkedIn

- Reach

- Engagement

- Follower growth

- Watch time and retention

- Inbound leads

I’m looking for someone who wants to **take ownership of the content function and grow with the business**, rather than someone who simply wants to complete editing tasks.



**Immediate start available.**

title: Short-Form Video Content Creator / Editor
description:
Ongoing Freelance Position | Remote | Weddings & Live Events



Marquee Events is looking for a talented short-form video content creator/editor to join our creative team on an ongoing freelance basis.



We are a high-energy wedding entertainment and production company based in the United States. Our weddings combine incredible music, packed dance floors, lighting, production and live entertainment with an energy that often feels more like a nightclub, concert or festival than a traditional wedding reception.



We want someone who can take the footage from those events and turn it into 30–60 second vertical videos that grab attention immediately, tell an epic story and make an engaged couple think:



"I WANT MY WEDDING TO FEEL LIKE THAT."



Content will primarily be created for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts.



WE NEED A CREATOR, NOT JUST AN EDITOR



We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to operate editing software.



We want someone who can open a folder containing a large amount of raw event footage and see the finished video inside of it.



You need to be able to find the moments that matter, identify incredible 2-second reactions buried inside longer clips, choose the music, create the hook, build the energy and tell the story.



Eventually, we'd like to upload footage from a wedding and be able to say:



"Here's the event. Show us what you can create."



Most of our videos are fast-paced, high-energy and music-driven, but occasionally an event may call for something more emotional or cinematic.



We want to develop a recognizable Marquee Events style while still incorporating new ideas, trends, audio and editing techniques when they fit our brand.



RAW 360° EXPERIENCE IS A MAJOR REQUIREMENT



A significant amount of our footage is captured with an Insta360 X5.



You will receive RAW 360° footage directly from the camera.



We are NOT going to select the camera angles, reframe the footage or export traditional video clips before sending it to you.



You need to be comfortable doing that yourself.



You should be proficient with:



RAW Insta360 footage

360° reframing

Keyframing camera movement

Following subjects

Pans, rotations, zooms and perspective changes

Creating vertical 9:16 shots from 360° footage

Finding unique angles inside a 360° scene

Mixing 360° footage with traditional footage



We don't care whether you use Insta360 Studio, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or another workflow.



We care about what you create.



If you have never worked directly with RAW 360° footage, this probably isn't the right position for you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH



Our content is primarily captured using:



DJI Osmo Pocket 3

Insta360 X5

iPhone

GoPro/action cameras

Professional cameras

Other miscellaneous event footage



You'll be working with packed dance floors, bride & groom moments, huge crowd reactions, DJs, live musicians, lighting, production, venue shots, behind-the-scenes content, funny moments, emotional moments and everything else that happens throughout a wedding.



Part of your job is taking footage from several different sources and making it feel like one cohesive piece of content.



MUSIC MATTERS



In most cases, you will select the music.



Watch the footage first and choose the audio that fits THAT event.



Most videos will be high-energy, but occasionally the story may call for something more emotional.



We also don't want to hear the same trending audio repeated from video to video.



Strong musical instincts are very important to us.



CREATIVE FREEDOM + COLLABORATION



Sometimes you'll receive almost complete creative freedom.



Other times, we'll go through the footage ourselves and send you a short shot list of moments we absolutely love and would like incorporated.



Think:



"Here are some moments we love. Build something incredible around them."



Even when we give you specific shots, we still want you finding additional moments, selecting the best 360° angles, choosing the music and determining how everything fits together.



We're looking for collaboration, not someone waiting for step-by-step editing instructions.



WE'RE EXPANDING OUR CREATIVE TEAM



We currently work with a content creator who does a good job.



We are NOT replacing him.



We're looking for another creative perspective.



Another set of eyes.



Another style.



Another person who may connect differently with our events and find things in the footage that we didn't see.



Strong RAW 360° creativity is especially important.



THE CONTENT



Our primary videos will be:



Main Highlights



30–60 seconds designed to immediately grab attention and tell the story of the event.



We're also beginning to create:



Quick Hitters



Approximately 8–12 second micro-teasers built around several incredible moments designed purely to STOP THE SCROLL and create excitement for the full video.



Some weddings may also generate additional standalone clips.



During slower periods we may revisit older event footage, and occasionally we'll create larger marketing pieces using multiple weddings, including Year in Rewind style videos showcasing epic moments throughout the year.



WORKLOAD & TURNAROUND



This is an ongoing freelance position, not an exclusive full-time role.



Expect a minimum of approximately:



1 video per week



Many weeks may include 2–3 videos, depending on our event schedule.



There may also be opportunities for additional work through another event professional we work closely with.



Our ideal turnaround for a typical video is approximately:



2–3 days.



Wedding work is seasonal, so volume will vary throughout the year.



HOW TO APPLY

PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY.

DO NOT SEND US YOUR ENTIRE PORTFOLIO.



We do NOT want your general portfolio website, Behance page, Google Drive containing everything you've ever edited or 20 different video links.



We don't want to search through your entire career trying to find something relevant.



SEND US TWO LINKS:

LINK #1: INTRODUCTION



Ideally, send us a short video introducing yourself.



Tell us a little about who you are and why you think you'd be a good fit.



If English isn't your strongest language, a written introduction or resume is completely fine.



We'd love to get to know the people who may eventually become part of our creative team.



LINK #2: ONE VIDEO



Send us ONE direct link to ONE video you personally created that MOST CLOSELY resembles the type of content we're describing.



ONE VIDEO. Choose carefully.



It does NOT need to be a wedding.



It could be a music festival, nightclub, concert, DJ performance, high-energy event, sports, travel, lifestyle or anything else that demonstrates the style we're looking for.



Send us the video that makes you think:



"If they like THIS, I'm probably the right creator for them."



If it includes RAW 360° footage that you personally reframed and edited, even better.



ALSO TELL US:

Your experience working with RAW Insta360 / 360° footage

What software you use

Your typical turnaround time

Your price per finished 30–60 second video



And include the phrase:



WEDDING ENTERTAINMENT REIMAGINED



somewhere in your response so we know you actually read this posting.



NEXT STEP: CREATIVE AUDITION
