title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Senior IT Engineer



Prevent problems before they happen. Automate what shouldn’t be done twice. Do great work with great clients — and earn the autonomy to do it your way.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to close tickets faster. You’re here to make sure the same problem doesn’t come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.



We’re looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You’ll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You’ll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best engineers we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: “How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a problem is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s fully resolved, documented, and won’t come back

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I fix this faster?” they ask “why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?”

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to



Who Thrives Here



People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we’ve also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren’t in conflict here.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that’s not a problem — it’s the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn’t just to solve the problem in front of you — it’s to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.



That looks like:



Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms

Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become i

Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely

Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery

Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes

Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent

Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust

Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you’ve seen enough environments to know what good looks like

Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don’t need to look up the basics

Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack

Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it

PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems

Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them

VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating

Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix

Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients’ environments.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve taken full ownership of your client environments

Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them

You know where the gaps are and you’ve already started closing them



At 6 months:



Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster

Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first



At 12 months:



Clients notice the quality difference

The “this issue again?” 
nts have dropped significantly

Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you

You’ve shaped how we operate — and the business is investing in your next step



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next

You fix the symptom and move on without asking why

You treat documentation as someone else’s responsibility

You’re comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Revenue Manager – Short-Term & Mid-Term Rentals (Remote)
description:
About Us



We are a growing company that helps property owners transform their properties into high-performing short-term and mid-term rentals. We combine hospitality, technology, operations, and revenue management to create exceptional guest experiences while maximizing returns for our clients.



We are a fast-growing remote-first company that values ownership, problem-solving, continuous improvement, and a commitment to excellence. Our team works across multiple markets and collaborates closely to deliver world-class service to both guests and property owners.



Position Overview



The Revenue Manager will be responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously refining pricing strategies for our short-term and mid-term rental portfolio.



While we currently utilize PriceLabs, we are seeking someone who understands the platform deeply but is not dependent on it. The ideal candidate can leverage PriceLabs where beneficial while also possessing the expertise to analyze markets independently, make strategic pricing decisions, and potentially transition portions of the portfolio to a more hands-on revenue management approach.

* Conduct ongoing competitor analysis and market research

* Present recommendations and insights to leadership

* Track portfolio performance against revenue targets and KPIs

Requirements



* Proven experience in revenue management for short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, hotels, or mid-term rentals

title: Youtube Video
description:
*** MUST HAVE MADE VIRAL YOUTUBE VIDEOS IN THE PAST AND CAN SHOW PROOF! ***



** SHOW ME YOUR YOUTUBE VIDEOS THAT HAVE OVER 100,000 VIEWS IN YOUR APPLICATION!**





Hi, I've got an idea for a youtube video,



Could you please help me to make the video via editing, thumbnail design, etc.



The video idea is:





The DRAM/RAM price crisis (Computer Tech)



A sustained, ongoing memory-chip price shock — DDR5 prices have roughly quadrupled since late 2025, driven by AI data centers eating up global DRAM/HBM capacity — that directly affects the cost of every PC, laptop, and console anyone in this audience might buy. It's covered almost nowhere in the dataset.



Evidence it would perform: Inside the dataset, the only channel that touched this topic — Evolving AI, with "This Chinese Company Destroyed The DDR5 RAM Prices Over Night" — hit 9.87x and 8.0x its own channel median on two related videos, by far the strongest topic-level signal found anywhere in the re-analysis. Independently, this is one of the most heavily covered ongoing stories in tech trade press right now (Tom's Hardware, TechRadar, SCMP, Wccftech all running near-daily updates through August 2026), with real consumer stakes (RTX 5080 Super delays, laptops shipping with 8GB RAM as a cost workaround).



Why it's currently a gap: It's a supply-chain/pricing story, not a product reveal — no shiny hardware to show on screen, and it requires some comfort with market dynamics (contract vs. spot pricing, HBM vs. DDR5) that most reactive news-format channels skip in favor of simpler "company announces thing" stories.



How to capitalise on it: Treat it as a recurring beat, not a one-off — "what this means for your next PC/laptop purchase" is evergreen as long as the shortage continues (analysts don't expect relief before 2027–2028), and it's a natural home for the Milestone/Superlative framing that already performs well in this niche ("prices have DOUBLED," "the biggest RAM price jump in X years").





Please let me know your thoughts? Thanks.

title: Medical Sales Representative - Cold Calling
description:
About Us

We’re building a global talent pool of high-performing remote Medical Sales Representatives (Cold Callers) to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative, and allied health support.



Our mission is simple: help more people access care through ethical, respectful outreach and a warm, professional patient-first approach.



If you’re confident on the phone, resilient, and enjoy hitting targets without being pushy, we’d love to meet you.



Role Overview

As a Sales Representative (Cold Calling), you’ll be the first voice many people hear. You’ll contact warm and/or cold leads, introduce clinic services, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments or drive next steps (e.g., intake form completion, discovery call scheduling).



This is a pooling / talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to clinic openings based on:

 • Your sales experience (healthcare preferred but not required)

 • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US)

 • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialers/SMS/email)

 • Compensation alignment and performance expectations



Important: This is healthcare-related outreach. We prioritize professionalism, consent-based communication, and privacy-safe handling of lead data.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 • Make outbound calls to leads (cold, warm, or reactivation lists, depending on clinic assignment).

 • Qualify prospects using a script and criteria (needs, location, readiness, eligibility, where applicable).

 • Clearly explain services and next steps in simple, human language (no hype, no pressure).

 • Book appointments or schedule a consult, and ensure the lead receives confirmations and instructions.

 • Follow up via SMS/email/CRM to reduce no-shows and improve conversion.

 • Handle objections professionally (price, hesitation, timing, trust) and escalate clinical questions appropriately.

 • Keep CRM records accurate: call outcomes, notes, tags, follow-up tasks, and dispositions.

 • Hit activity and outcome targets (calls/day, connects, qualified appointments, show rate).

 • Coordinate with patient support/ops teams for smooth handoffs and accurate scheduling.

 • Maintain compliance: respect do-not-contact rules (if provided), consent preferences, and confidentiality.

 • Participate in coaching, script optimization, and performance reviews.



Must-Have Qualifications

 • 2+ years experience in cold calling / outbound sales/appointment setting (B2C or B2B).

 • Strong spoken and written English with confident phone presence.

 • Comfortable following scripts while sounding natural and empathetic.

 • Resilient mindset: can handle rejection and stay consistent day-to-day.

 • Organized and metrics-driven (can work toward targets and track progress).

 • Strong attention to detail for CRM updates and follow-up scheduling accuracy.

 • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and clear async communication.

 • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan.

 • Willingness to work shifts overlapping AU/UK/US/NZ depending on assignment.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Experience selling or booking for healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or subscription services.

 • Experience with consultative selling (needs-based approach vs hard selling).

 • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho) and dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, Dialpad).

 • SMS/email follow-up experience (Twilio, Podium, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.).

 • Strong objection handling and ability to improve scripts through feedback.

 • Experience with compliance-minded outreach (opt-outs, consent language, data privacy).



Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

 • CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel

 • Dialer/VoIP: RingCentral, Dialpad, Aircall, CloudTalk

 • SMS/Email: Podium, Twilio, Gmail/Outlook

 • Productivity: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion/Trello/Asana

 • Reporting: Google Sheets



Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Location: Philippines (remote)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clean handoffs.



Compensation (General Guidance)

 • Starts at USD 10/hour

 • Many clinic assignments include performance incentives, such as:

 • bonus per qualified appointment booked

 • bonus per attended appointment (show rate)

 • monthly performance bonus for hitting targets

Details vary by clinic and will be confirmed during matching.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your cold calling/sales background (industry + results)

 • Your best achievement (e.g., appointments booked/week, conversion rate, revenue)

 • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialer/SMS/email)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

 • A short example of how you handle a tough objection politely



Important: Applications missing the required CV + video may not be considered.



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Practical task: short role-play + CRM note sample + follow-up message draft

 • Structured interview: scenarios on objection handling, ethics, and performance consistency



Join the Pool

If you’re persuasive without being pushy, love the rhythm of outbound calls, and want to help more people access care, we’d love to hear from you.

Expert in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

Strong understanding of dielines, bleed, safe zones, gussets, folds, and seal areas

Experience preparing print-ready files for packaging suppliers

Knowledge of CMYK, Pantone, spot colors, white ink, varnish, foil, and print finishes

Experience working with nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens, barcodes, and food labeling layouts

Ability to communicate with printers and suppliers

Strong attention to detail

Portfolio with real printed packaging examples required



This position is not suitable for designers who only do branding, social media, logos, or mockups. We need someone with real packaging print-production experience.

title: Virtual Administrative Assistant | Lead Gen Research
description:
Steez Consulting is looking for a dependable, resourceful, and highly organized Virtual Administrative Assistant to support our growing company.



This is a part-time, long-term position designed for someone who wants the opportunity to grow with a company rather than simply complete short-term freelance projects.



The position will begin with a relatively light workload consisting primarily of administrative support, online research, lead and referral partner research,
 management, follow-ups, CRM updates, and other recurring business tasks.



While you will need to be reasonably available and responsive during our designated working hours, this is not a full-time workload. There will often be downtime between assignments, and you are free to handle other work during those periods as long as our tasks are completed on time and communication remains responsive.



Our goal is to find the right person now and gradually increase their responsibilities, hours, and compensation as the company grows. A strong performer can eventually grow into a more important full-time administrative, executive assistant, or operations role within the company.



Starting Compensation



Starting compensation is $50 USD per week during the introductory part-time phase.



This is structured as a weekly compensation arrangement rather than a traditional hourly position because the role includes a combination of active task work and availability during working hours.



The initial workload will be limited. Compensation will be reevaluated as the employee demonstrates reliability, takes ownership of additional responsibilities, and the workload increases.



We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity and advancement within the company.



Schedule & Availability



You should be available during designated U.S. Eastern Time business hours Monday through Friday.



This does not mean you will be actively working during the entire availability window.



Some days may include several hours of research or administrative assignments, while other days may consist primarily of monitoring communications, completing follow-ups, or handling occasional requests.



Research and data-related assignments may require approximately 2–3 hours of focused work on certain days.



During downtime, you may work on other projects or responsibilities as long as:



* Assigned tasks are completed by their deadlines

* You remain reasonably responsive during the agreed working hours

*
s and time-sensitive requests are handled promptly

* Communication is consistent and reliable



Specific working and availability hours will be discussed with selected applicants.



Primary Responsibilities

s, phone numbers, websites, LinkedIn profiles, and other contact information

s

 responses

s and messages

title: Business Development Representative
description:
# Business Development & Prospecting Specialist



**DumpStor of Tulsa**



## Position Summary



The **Business Development & Prospecting Specialist** supports DumpStor of Tulsa's growth by identifying, contacting, qualifying, and cultivating prospective commercial customers and referral partners. The Specialist must be able to work U.S. Central time zone core business hours. Outbound calls must be made between 9:00am CT and 3:00pm CT. 



This is primarily an **outbound prospecting and lead-development role**, rather than a closing sales or dispatch position. The Specialist will work from DumpStor's Master Prospecting List, research new prospects, conduct outbound calls, identify businesses that use roll-off dumpsters, introduce DumpStor's services, send follow-up communications, maintain accurate prospect records, and route qualified opportunities to the appropriate DumpStor team member.



The goal of the position is to build a consistent pipeline of qualified business opportunities while providing every contact with a professional, friendly, low-pressure introduction to DumpStor of Tulsa.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Outbound Prospecting & Lead Qualification



* Conduct outbound calls to businesses identified on the DumpStor Master Prospecting List.

* Introduce DumpStor of Tulsa and its dumpster rental services using approved messaging and scripts.

* Determine whether businesses use roll-off dumpsters and, when applicable, gather information regarding:



  * How dumpsters are used, including job sites, permanent locations, or both.

  * Dumpster sizes typically used.

  * Approximate frequency of rentals.

  * Current dumpster provider, when voluntarily disclosed.

  * Satisfaction with the current provider.

  * Potential interest in an alternative or backup provider.

  * Upcoming projects or potential rental needs.

* Identify the individual responsible for coordinating dumpster rentals or vendor relationships and obtain accurate contact information.

* Recognize and appropriately route high-potential commercial opportunities.



### Prospect Research



* Research potential commercial customers within DumpStor's service area.

* Identify new businesses within designated target industries, including construction, remodeling/restoration, roofing, flooring, property management, real estate, landscaping, siding/windows, countertops/cabinets, cannabis businesses, and other approved categories.

* Gather available company information, including business name, address, telephone number, website, business category, and appropriate contact information.

* Add qualified prospects to the Master Prospecting List in accordance with DumpStor procedures.

* Avoid duplicate records and maintain accurate, usable prospect information.



### Prospect Follow-Up & Relationship Development



* Conduct scheduled follow-up calls with previously contacted prospects according to established priority and callback protocols.

* Position DumpStor as a potential primary or backup dumpster provider when appropriate.

* Maintain professional relationships with prospects who may not have an immediate need but represent future business opportunities.

* Use approved promotional and referral offers when applicable.

* Respect established vendor relationships and maintain a consultative, non-aggressive approach.

* Immediately honor requests not to receive additional prospecting calls.



###
 Follow-Up



* Send approved follow-up
s after prospecting conversations when appropriate.

* Provide approved DumpStor brochures, pricing information, promotional offers, and other materials.

* Personalize approved templates based on the substance of the conversation without making unauthorized commitments or representations.

* Ensure follow-up communications are completed promptly and accurately documented.



### Prospect Tracking & Documentation



Maintain complete and accurate information in the DumpStor Master Prospecting List, including:



* Call attempts and dates.

* Contact and decision-maker information.

* Call disposition.

* Dumpster usage and frequency.

* Current provider information when available.

* Prospect priority/status.

* Follow-up
s sent.

* Promotional offers provided.

* Next action and next-action date.

* Internal routing or handoff.

* Relevant notes from conversations.



A prospecting interaction is not considered complete until the required documentation, follow-up communication, next action, and internal routing have been completed.



### Lead Classification & Routing



Classify prospects according to DumpStor's established system:



* **Red:** High-priority or immediate opportunity.

* **Orange:** Qualified prospect with legitimate potential but no immediate purchasing signal.

* **Yellow:** Longer-term or lower-frequency opportunity.

* **Gray:** Business/referral relationship that is not currently a meaningful dumpster prospect.

* **Green:** Existing DumpStor customer.



Route prospects according to established procedures:



* **Ali/Dispatch:** Account setup, routine backup-provider relationship, Docket-related setup, booking, scheduling, and operational questions.

* **Audrey/Allen:** High-value prospects, recurring commercial opportunities, pricing negotiations, strategic relationships, dissatisfied competitor customers, or prospects requiring customized solutions.



### Reporting & Performance Tracking



Provide accurate activity and pipeline information for DumpStor's weekly prospecting scorecard, including:



* Calls attempted.

* Unique businesses contacted.

* Live contacts.

* Decision-makers reached.

* Follow-up
s sent.

* New prospects researched and added.

* Dumpster users identified.

* Qualified opportunities.

* Backup-provider opportunities.

* Promotional offers made.

* Red, Orange, and Yellow leads generated.

* Leads routed to Ali.

* Leads routed to Audrey/Allen.

* Scheduled callbacks.

* Do-not-call requests.

* Other agreed-upon prospecting metrics.



Work with DumpStor to ensure reported activity reconciles with information maintained in the Master Prospecting List.



## Approved Sales Authority



The Business Development & Prospecting Specialist may:



* Explain DumpStor's approved products and services.

* Quote approved standard pricing.

* Communicate approved rental terms and included tonnage.

* Explain approved additional charges.

* Offer approved promotional codes to eligible prospects.

* Explain DumpStor's service area.

* Discuss approved features and benefits.

* Position DumpStor as a primary or backup dumpster provider.



The Specialist **may not independently**:



* Negotiate commercial or contractor pricing.

* Offer unauthorized discounts.

* Modify promotional offers.

* Waive established fees.

* Guarantee delivery or pickup times without confirmation.

* Promise availability.

* Agree to contract terms on behalf of DumpStor.

* Make exceptions to service-area, waste, placement, or other operational requirements.

* Make representations about DumpStor's services that are not contained in approved materials.



Questions or opportunities outside established authority must be referred to the appropriate DumpStor representative.



## Customer Service Expectations



The Specialist serves as a representative of DumpStor of Tulsa and is expected to:



* Communicate in a friendly, professional, confident, and conversational manner.

* Treat prospects as potential long-term relationships rather than simply names on a calling list.

* Avoid aggressive or high-pressure sales tactics.

* Respect businesses that are satisfied with their current providers.

* Never criticize or disparage competitors.

* Provide accurate information and never guess when an answer is unknown.

* Clearly distinguish confirmed information from items requiring DumpStor approval.

* Protect confidential company, customer, and prospect information.

* Maintain accurate records of all substantive communications.



DumpStor's approach should be:



**"We don't need to replace a provider who is serving you well. We'd simply like the opportunity to become another resource you can call when you need us."**



## Desired Qualifications



The ideal Business Development & Prospecting Specialist will have:



* Experience in outbound calling, business development, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service, or a similar role.

* Strong telephone communication and interpersonal skills.

* Comfort speaking with business owners, contractors, office managers, project managers, and other decision-makers.

* Ability to ask questions and listen rather than simply read a sales script.

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

* Accurate data-entry and documentation habits.

* Ability to manage scheduled callbacks and multiple prospect relationships.

* Comfort conducting basic online business research.

* Professional written communication skills.

* Ability to learn and accurately communicate pricing, service information, and business procedures.

* Sound judgment regarding when an opportunity should be escalated.

* Ability to work independently while following established processes and scripts.



Experience working with contractors, construction businesses, home services, property management, waste services, or other B2B service businesses is helpful but not required.



## Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on both **activity and quality**, rather than call volume alone.



Key indicators may include:



* Consistent outbound prospecting activity.

* Quality and accuracy of prospect research.

* Decision-maker contact rate.

* Number and quality of qualified prospects generated.

* Backup-provider opportunities developed.

* High-priority leads generated.

* Timeliness and quality of follow-up.

* Accuracy of prospect records.

* Adherence to callback schedules.

* Quality of internal handoffs.

* Prospect-to-customer conversions tracked by DumpStor.

* Contribution to new and recurring commercial business.



The Specialist is expected to focus on developing a **quality business-development pipeline**, not simply maximizing the number of calls made.



## Working Relationship



The Business Development & Prospecting Specialist will work closely with DumpStor of Tulsa's owners and dispatch team. DumpStor will provide approved prospecting materials, scripts, pricing information, service-area information, promotional offers, follow-up templates, and access to the Master Prospecting List.



The Specialist is responsible for following DumpStor's established procedures and promptly communicating significant opportunities, customer concerns, questions, or issues requiring internal attention.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy



Remote — Philippines | Full-Time



About the Role



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked, this role may be for you.



**Rohring Results** is a US-based marketing agency providing **SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development** for clients across multiple industries.



We are hiring a **Strategy Manager** to own the strategic direction behind our client work.



This is **not a single-channel marketing role**. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan.



More importantly:



**This is a research job with a strategy title.**



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it.



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem.



What You'll Actually Do



1. Lead Client Strategy



You will own the strategy for new clients, including:



* Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction

* Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan

* Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities

* Determining what should be prioritized and why

* Translating research into clear strategic recommendations

* Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research



You will personally conduct or direct research involving:



* Buyer and audience research

* Customer personas

* Competitive analysis

* Industry and market research

* Brand positioning

* Audience research for paid campaigns

* Competitor messaging and offer analysis

* Market trends and opportunities



We are looking for someone who actually **does the research**, not someone who simply delegates it.



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable.



3. Build Brand Foundations



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning.



You will help establish:



* Brand positioning

* Differentiation

* Target audience

* Brand voice

* Key messaging

* Value propositions

* Messaging angles



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables.



**You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why.**



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client.



You will:



* Review content and creative deliverables

* Identify when something does not align with strategy

* Give clear and actionable feedback

* Approve or reject work before client delivery

* Explain *why* something needs to change

* Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it.



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy



You will determine:



* Target audience

* Campaign objective

* Offer

* Messaging angle

* Sequence

* Call to action



Our copywriter will write the
s.



**You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work.**



6. Analyze Client Performance



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools.



But generating a report is only the beginning.



You will need to determine:



* What actually happened?

* Why did it happen?

* Which numbers matter?

* Which numbers are misleading?

* What changed from the previous period?

* What should we do next?

* Does the data actually support the story the report is telling?



We need someone who can **question the report, not just format it.**



---



AI Is a Major Part of This Role



Every agency says it uses AI.



Here's what we actually mean.



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different.



**Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong.**



You will be expected to:



* Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries

* Build effective prompts and research workflows

* Iterate instead of accepting the first response

* Cross-check AI-generated information

* Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations

* Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know

* Know when AI should **not** be used

* Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate

* Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources



**Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true.**



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly.



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that *looked correct but wasn't*—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it.



---



What You'll Own



* Overall marketing strategy for new clients

* Integrated multi-channel strategy

* Market and industry research

* Buyer and audience research

* Competitive analysis

* Brand positioning and differentiation

* Customer personas

* Paid advertising audience strategy

* Content and creative direction

* Content and creative approval

*
 campaign strategy

* Client performance reporting

* Strategic recommendations based on performance data

* Ongoing independent research

* Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks



Dedicated Research Time



A portion of every week will be protected for **research that is not tied to a specific client**.



This is intentional.



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities.



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output.



That's the point.



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable.



---



What We're Looking For



Required



**Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience**



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including:



* SEO

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Social Media

* Content Marketing

*
 Marketing

* Brand Strategy



We are **not** looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others.



Strong Research Experience



You have personally conducted work such as:



* Market research

* Competitive analysis

* Customer research

* Personas

* Brand positioning

* Audience research

* Industry analysis



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail.



Genuine Curiosity



One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity.



We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it.



It does not have to be marketing.



Strong AI Research Skills



You understand AI as a **research and reasoning instrument**, not simply a faster way to write.



You should be comfortable:



* Prompting

* Iterating

* Fact-checking

* Comparing sources

* Challenging AI outputs

* Building repeatable AI research workflows



We may assess this skill live.



### Strong Critical Thinking



You naturally ask:



* *How do we know this?*

* *What is the source?*

* *What assumption are we making?*

* *What would prove this wrong?*

* *Is there another explanation?*

* *What information are we missing?*



Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback



You will have authority over work produced by other team members.



You need to be comfortable saying:



**“This isn't right yet.”**



More importantly, you need to explain exactly **what needs to change and why.**



Self-Directed



Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline.



You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next.



### Communication



* Excellent written English

* Strong analytical communication

* Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues

* Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly

* Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions



---



Nice to Have



Experience with:



* Digital marketing agencies

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Paid audience and targeting strategy

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* SEO platforms and analytics

* Marketing dashboards and reporting

* Competitive intelligence

* Brand strategy

* Marketing automation

* AI research workflows

* Creating documented processes that another person can follow



---



What This Job Is NOT



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for:



* A content writing position

* An SEO specialist position

* A paid ads specialist position

* A social media manager position

* A role where someone else provides the strategy

* A position where you simply execute instructions

* A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster



**Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute.**



**You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working.**



---



About the Working Environment



This is a senior individual contributor position



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority.



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval.



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered.



Our delivery team primarily works on **Philippine hours**, including daily stand-ups.



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process.



---



How to Apply



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following:



1. A Research Question You Answered Well



Tell us:



* What were you trying to find out?

* How did you conduct the research?

* What sources did you use?

* How did you evaluate the information?

* How did you know your conclusion was reliable?

* What decision did the research ultimately influence?



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer



Tell us about a situation where:



* An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable

* You discovered that it was wrong or misleading

* Explain how you identified the problem

* Explain how you verified the correct information

* Explain what you changed in your process afterward



**We read these answers before the rest of the application.**



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.



---

If you are naturally curious, skeptical of easy answers, comfortable with ambiguity, and genuinely enjoy figuring out *what is actually true*—we would like to meet you.



Apply with your CV and the two requested responses above. send to

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Marketing & Design Specialist
description:
About BBG



BBG supplies industrial and medical gases, hydraulic hose assemblies and industrial products throughout Bermuda.

We’re building on a long history while investing in the future. Under new leadership, we’re strengthening our people, systems and technology to build an organisation that becomes stronger over time.





The Opportunity



This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who combines excellent judgement with the technical skills to produce excellent finished work.

You will be primarily responsible for BBG’s marketing function, from understanding the problem or opportunity through execution and evaluation. Your work will span design, copywriting, website content,
 marketing, paid advertising, print, radio and other channels where appropriate.

We’re looking for someone interested in why marketing works: how customers make decisions, what makes communication effective and how different marketing channels can be used to solve business problems.

This isn’t a role where you’ll manage a marketing team or hand your ideas to other people to execute. You’ll need the hands-on capabilities to take work from idea through finished execution.

AI will be an important part of how you work. We expect you to use it extensively where it makes you better and faster. But AI is a tool, not the finished product. You’ll be responsible for evaluating its output, improving it and combining it with your own technical skills and judgement to produce excellent work.





Who We’re Looking For



Above all, you exercise good judgement and produce excellent finished work.



You:

Have a strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality design, marketing or creative work.

Have strong design and visual communication skills and can personally create polished materials.

Write very well in English and have a solid foundation in copywriting.

Understand marketing fundamentals and are curious about how customers make decisions.

Are comfortable working with websites,
 marketing, paid advertising and other digital marketing tools.

Can interpret marketing data and use it to improve your decisions.

Use AI effectively while applying your own judgement and technical skills to ensure the finished work meets a high standard.

Take responsibility for results, communicate openly and follow through on commitments.

You have a love of learning. When you don’t know something, you don’t pretend—you learn, ask questions, seek help when needed and figure things out.

Our current marketing technology stack includes Figma, Canva, Slack and modern AI tools. Experience with these tools—or comparable alternatives—is expected.





What Success Looks Like



Within your first year, BBG’s marketing should be noticeably better because you’re here.

Our materials should be more professional and consistent. Our communications should be clearer and more persuasive. Customers should find it easier to understand what we offer and the value we create. Our campaigns should become increasingly informed by evidence about what works.

Better systems, reusable assets and thoughtful use of AI should also allow us to produce better marketing with greater speed and consistency.





Ultimately, the standard is the finished work and whether it works.







Compensation



US$1,300–1,500 per month, depending on experience and capability. Full-time remote position.





Hiring Process



Our hiring process is designed to help both you and BBG determine whether we’re likely to be a strong long-term fit.





Application & Portfolio Review → Online Assessment → Short Video Response → Interview One → Paid Practical Assessment → Review of BBG’s Operating Manual → Final Interview → Offer







Your portfolio will be an important part of our selection process. We’re more interested in what you can actually produce, the judgement behind it and what you personally contributed than in impressive job titles.





 your resume and portfolio to 
 with subject line: Marketing & Design Specialist Application - [Your Name]





During the process, we’ll discuss work you’ve personally created and the thinking behind it. Candidates progressing to the practical stage will complete a paid assessment based on a real BBG business scenario.





You’ll be able to use AI and other tools just as you would in the role. We’ll evaluate your judgement, execution and use of the tools available to you—and, most importantly, the quality and effectiveness of the finished work.

title: Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser - Land Development & JV Modeling
description:
Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser — Land Development & JV Modeling

Fully Remote · Philippines-Based · Full-Time · US Central Time Shift · Reports Directly to the VP of Operations



Why This Role Exists

We are a Central Texas land development and investment firm doing what most of our competitors cannot: turning raw acreage tracts of varying sizes into fully platted, revenue-generating subdivisions. We move fast, we structure JVs directly with landowners, and we deploy real capital on real deals every month.



The problem: our deal flow is outrunning our modeling capacity. Feasibility studies, absorption schedules, and JV waterfalls are stacking up on the VP of Operations' desk — and every day one sits there is a day a deal moves slower. That is where you come in.



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

• You have taken 3+ live deals from raw acreage to landowner-ready JV pitch — independently.

• The VP of Operations and Founder review your models at the assumption layer, not the formula layer.

• Landowners see your work directly. Your name is on the pro forma at the meeting.



What You Will Actually Do

• Turn raw land into revenue models. Take a raw acreage tract — size depends on the project — decide the lot cut, allocate infrastructure cost, phase the release, and build the per-lot P&L.

• Model absorption like a real one. Monthly ramp schedules by phase — no flat annual averages, no divide-by-12.

• Run Sales Comparable Analyses on land and lots using aged, expired, and active comps to establish real value and defensible days-on-market.

• Build JV waterfalls that hold up under an attorney's audit — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits, land-contribution structures.

• Produce investor-facing return summaries (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash) for our own JV investment deals — reviewed by ownership and counsel prior to distribution.

• Package landowner-ready decks and spreadsheets that need no revisions before they hit a Zoom call.

• Sit in on live deal calls with US ownership and iterate on assumptions in real time.



Required — Non-Negotiable

• 3–5 years institutional real estate underwriting at Colliers, JLL, Leechiu, Santos Knight Frank, Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE PH, Ayala Land, Megaworld, SMDC, or equivalent.

• Portfolio of at least 2 land or JV models you personally built (anonymized acceptable).

• Demonstrated absorption rate modeling — you must be able to show a live sample ramped monthly schedule during the interview.

• Working knowledge of JV waterfall structures — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits.

• Advanced Excel — dynamic formulas, sensitivity/data tables, scenario toggles, INDEX/MATCH, XIRR.

• Fluent business English — written and spoken, for direct communication with US ownership and occasional landowner presentations.

• Willing and able to work US Central Time business hours — 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time (approximately 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a hard requirement: our deals happen on Texas time, and you sit on the Texas team.

Preferred (Not Required)

• MLS-based comp research experience (Highly Preferred). Comfort pulling and interpreting US MLS data is a big edge.

• Financial modeling certification: REFM (Levels 2–3), REFAI, CFI FMVA, Wall Street Prep REFM, or BIWS Real Estate Modeling. REFM Level 3 With Distinction is a strong plus but not required — reps beat certs.

• Prior exposure to US real estate — CoStar, LandVision, Redfin, MRICS, or US brokerage/PE experience.

• Civil engineering, surveying, or platting familiarity.



Compensation

Starting pay: $400 – $500 USD per week based on experience and demonstrated skill. Paid weekly via wire or approved remote-payment platform.



How to Apply

Send all three items to 
 with subject line: "RE Analyst — [Your Name]"

1. A sample land or JV waterfall model you personally built (anonymized OK).

2. Proof of any financial modeling certifications held (if applicable — not required to apply).

3. Availability windows for a 30-minute screening call within the next 10 business days.



Shortlisted candidates receive a 2-hour take-home underwriting test. Final round is a live screen-share with ownership. Serious applicants only — we read every submission personally.

title: Founder's Business Operations Partner - Client Growth & Global Systems
description:
An established founder-run business is entering a new phase. We are simplifying how revenue, customers, commitments, and management information move through the company so the model can later serve more markets.



This seat is for an operator who can turn ambiguity into an operating rhythm. You will work directly with the founder and stay close to customers, partners, financial activity, and the systems that connect them. Early work is deliberately concrete: pursue open opportunities, make commitments visible, investigate missing or late payments, assemble a useful cash and revenue view, and prevent unresolved issues from disappearing.



As trust grows, the mandate grows. You will help d
 which practices can become common standards, which need local variation, and what should be delegated, automated, or eliminated.



THE FIRST 90 DAYS



- Learn the customer journey, sources of revenue, cash calendar, important relationships, and recurring commitments

- Bring pipeline, onboarding, delivery status, billing, receivables, and next actions into one dependable management view

- Establish a short weekly founder brief covering cash, revenue opportunities, customer risks, decisions, and items that need intervention

- Personally pursue loose ends with customers, partners, vendors, and internal contributors until there is a clear resolution

- Examine the existing financial, CRM, and internal records for gaps, mismatches, and unclear responsibility

- Use our emerging internal software in real operating work and explain what information, controls, and workflows it still needs



AS THE SEAT GROWS



- Improve the path from first inquiry through proposal, onboarding, delivery, renewal, referral, and expansion

- Join selected sales, customer, and partner conversations, capture commitments, and make sure the business acts on what it learns

- Create procedures, dashboards, operating rules, and escalation paths that other people can follow

- Coordinate bookkeepers, accountants, and other specialists without surrendering responsibility for accurate operating information

- Design processes that can expand across regions while preserving necessary local differences

- Review work and eventually direct a small Philippine support layer when volume justifies it



EVIDENCE WE VALUE



- At least five years of increasing responsibility across business operations, account management, customer success, revenue or payment operations, SaaS implementation, client accounting services, agency or practice operations, merchant services, or founder support

- A record of personally solving customer, revenue, billing, payment, cash, reconciliation, or collections problems

- Financial fluency strong enough to question records, investigate discrepancies, understand cash movement, and hold technical specialists accountable

- Experience improving CRM discipline, management reporting, customer retention, sales follow-through, or team execution

- Evidence that you have trained people, reviewed work, led projects, or managed a small team

- Clear communication with US customers and careful handling of sensitive information

- Judgment about what deserves immediate attention, what can wait, and what should never reach the founder again

- Interest in one meaningful operating seat with room to grow, rather than adding another small client to an already full schedule



PRACTICAL ARRANGEMENT



- Initial commitment: 35 hours each week, Monday through Friday

- Work a consistent seven-hour daily schedule with at least five consecutive hours inside 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM Pacific Time

- Keep the five-hour overlap fixed to the Pacific clock when daylight-saving time changes; the remaining two hours may be arranged around it

- Starting compensation: PHP 80,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay

- Responsibility and compensation can grow when performance and business needs support it

- Disclose all current employment, clients, and recurring business obligations

- Final selection includes professional references and a paid work simulation



APPLICATION EVIDENCE



Start your response with BUILT TO SCALE and answer every item. We are looking for evidence and judgment, not polished generalities.



1. List your current employment, clients, businesses, and approximate weekly hours for each.

2. State the seven-hour daily schedule you would work, including the five consecutive hours inside our Pacific window, and confirm that you can keep the Pacific overlap year-round.

3. Tell us about a business problem that crossed departments or had no clear owner. What did you d
, do, and change permanently?

4. Give an example of a customer, partner, sales, retention, or expansion opportunity that improved because you kept pursuing it. Include the result.

5. Describe a financial mismatch you investigated, such as cash, billing, payment, reconciliation, or collections. Explain your reasoning and resolution.

6. Describe a workflow you made repeatable across customers, teams, sites, or regions. What remained common, and what could not be standardized?

7. If you joined a founder-led business with scattered information, what would you expect to make reliable by day 30, day 90, and month six?

8. Confirm the schedule and starting compensation, whether you can provide two professional references, and whether you will complete a paid work simulation.



Never include passwords, credentials, private customer information, unredacted financial records, or confidential employer material.

title: Freelance Content Marketer & Content Creator
description:
We’re looking for a freelance content marketer and content creator with strong editorial judgment, audience awareness, and the ability to turn business goals into useful, engaging content.



This is a flexible, project-based GIG. We will start with a small number of assignments—about 5–10 hours per week depending on workload. If we find a strong fit, there is potential for regular ongoing work and more projects, but this is not a full-time role at present.



The work is centered on content marketing: understanding the audience, finding strong content angles, creating high-quality content, adapting it across channels, and improving it based on results. We do not want keyword-stuffed or bulk-generated content.



TYPICAL PROJECTS



• Research audiences, customer problems, competitors, topics, and relevant trends.

• Turn business goals and audience needs into useful content ideas, briefs, outlines, and small campaigns.

• Write and edit blog posts, landing pages, guides, newsletters, case studies, campaign copy, and other marketing content.

• Turn one strong idea into multiple formats for social media,
, and other channels.

• Maintain a clear, consistent brand voice while adapting tone and format for different audiences and platforms.

• Fact-check claims and use reliable sources.

• Review content performance and suggest practical improvements.

• Apply sensible on-page SEO where relevant, including search intent, headings, internal links, metadata, and natural topic coverage.

• Structure content clearly so it can also be understood and cited by AI-powered search and answer engines.

• Deliver polished work on time and communicate progress clearly.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A portfolio of polished, published English-language content.

• Demonstrable experience in content marketing, content creation, copywriting, or editorial work.

• Strong storytelling, structure, tone, clarity, and attention to detail.

• Ability to understand an audience and create content that is useful, original, and aligned with a business goal.

• Ability to develop an idea—not simply rewrite or summarize existing articles.

• Ability to adapt content for long-form, social media,
, and other formats.

• Strong research, fact-checking, editing, and source-evaluation skills.

• Good organization, communication, and reliability in a remote working environment.

• Responsible use of AI tools, with human judgment, verification, and substantial editing.

• A practical understanding of SEO is helpful. Experience with GEO or AI search optimization is a plus.



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience with WordPress or another CMS.

• Familiarity with analytics, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar tools.

• Experience creating content briefs, editorial calendars, content series, or topic clusters.

• Experience measuring engagement, traffic, leads, conversions, or other content outcomes.

• Experience with social media content,
 marketing, or conversion copywriting.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “Clear Content” so we know you read the full post.



Please include:



1. A short introduction explaining why this gig fits you.

2. Links to three relevant English-language content samples. Include at least one long-form piece and one social media or campaign example, and state exactly what you contributed.

3. One example of content you created that supported a business goal or improved engagement, traffic, leads, conversions, or another result. Include context and numbers where available.

4. Your concise answers to the screening questions below.

5. Your weekly availability and expected hourly rate.



SCREENING QUESTIONS



1. Choose one sample from your portfolio. Who was the audience, what was the business goal, and why did you choose that angle and format?

2. If you were given one strong topic idea, how would you turn it into a small content campaign across long-form content and two other channels?

title: Long form video editor
description:

Adding on-screen text for key quotes (we'll mark which lines need text overlay)

 — "You Won't Believe How SAVAGE Sean Connery Was" (Belmorra channel, runs about 4-6 minutes). We're not copying this exact channel, but this is a close match for the pacing, tone, and editing rhythm we want — warm, punchy, well-timed cuts between narration and clips. Note: our own episodes run a bit longer (6-8 minutes), so the pacing should stretch slightly without dragging.



What we're looking for:
